articleTitle: On-board autodyne velocity sensors for aeroballistic inspections
abstract: The problem of implementation of the miniature on-board velocity sensors for articles' drop at rather strict restrictions on the size and mass of apparatuses as well as on the power consumption is solved using the autodyne oscillator on Gunn diode. In this paper the sense of the technical solutions is revealed in brief and the construction description for two offered devices is given, which were successfully applied at the ground articles' testing.

articleTitle: Measurement methods of complex permittivity and permeability of sheet samples in free space in microwave range
abstract: A set of measurement methods of complex permittivity and permeability of sheet samples in free space in microwave range is elaborated. The measurements are realized in wide frequency band for comparatively small samples (compared to several wavelengths) with high accuracy due to using of Time Domain and compensation procedure on diaphragmatic horn antennas.

articleTitle: Investigation of regenerating properties of UHF active oscillator on basis of bipolar tranzistor
abstract: The results of investigation and computer modeling of operation of the oscillator are described, the problems of determination of generalized regenerating characteristic of UHF-active oscillator on the basis of a bipolar transistor are shown. The generalized regenerating characteristic allows defining of decrement coefficient of a resonant circuit of active oscillator that depend on the modes of operation for direct and alternating currents.

articleTitle: The double gap resonator oscillator with a buffer stage
abstract: The numerical procedure and the program for carrying out of mathematical modeling and computing experiment for the purpose investigation probes and a projection of a generating-amplifying klystron are developed. Equations for the generating characteristic, of starting current and beam perveance are yielded. When using the generating section on Π oscillation mode, the calculating efficiency of 65 % is obtained.

articleTitle: Investigation of parameters of models of acoustic echo-signals by method of correlation estimation
abstract: Problems of correlation estimation of a delay in channels of distribution of acoustic echo-signals are considered. Possible methods of solution of the problems are submitted. The expressions of defining of accuracy of estimation in the presence of peak and phase distortions in the channels are obtained.

articleTitle: Spatial encoding in MIMO communication system in the presence of simulated multipath
abstract: The investigation of transmission capacity of MIMO mobile communication system designed on principles of multipath effect has been carried out. Spatial encoding is realized by the beamforming method. Power distribution along transmit and receive antennas is specified by the principle of “water-filling”.

articleTitle: Synthesis principles for multimode waveguide units
abstract: We propose principles which represent a systematic approach to the synthesis of multimode waveguides converting a specific input field into a different output field. Using these principles, fast and efficient methods of synthesis with specified properties can be constructed for any field analysis method. Synthesized waveguide components are presented to demonstrate their efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of perspective antenna systems with controlled 3-dimensional signal space division
abstract: The antenna system with controlled 3-dimentional signal space division constructions and characteristics for all radio frequency range investigation are reviewed in this work.

articleTitle: Currents through a membrane taking into account the presence of high-frequency components
abstract: Boundary vibration frequencies that influence passive transference of ions through biological membranes taking into account the law of distribution of the concentration on the membrane depth were calculated. By the examples the distribution of high-frequency components of current density on the depth of membrane for different ions, and their influence on the general transference of ions through the membrane of a cell, are shown.

articleTitle: General method of digital image restoration
abstract: The pre-processing of digital images within the framework of the general method of digital image restoration based on Wiener technique allowing us to obtain information about additive noise using distorted image is presented.

articleTitle: Trial-and-error procedure of parametres of electromagnetic fields for therapeutic intervention
abstract: The possibilities of existing trial and error methods of electromagnetic fields of various bands for problem solution of therapy are analyzed.

articleTitle: Allocation of electromagnetic field in a dehumidifier column for adsorbent regeneration
abstract: The present paper concerns a problem solution of electromagnetic energy allocation in a coaxial box for adsorbent regeneration by microwave heating in a dehumidifier column.

articleTitle: Interaction of low-intensity electromagnetic fields of light range with biological objects
abstract: The interaction of electromagnetic radiation of the light range with biological objects is explored. The parameters indicating changes of reaction of an object on external influence of low-intensity coherent radiation are defined.

articleTitle: Method of optimal UAV network topology control
abstract: Proposed a method for optimal control of UAV network topology based on adaptive algorithms of UAV's network placement and movement in space to enhance the connectivity of wireless ad hoc networks (WaN).

articleTitle: Optimal length of rarefied antenna arrays with maximum gain
abstract: The rarefied (d > 0,5λ) inphase linear antenna arrays of isotropic radiators, Hertzian dipoles and half-wavelength dipoles located over the screen are investigated. The dependence of directional characteristics of such arrays vs. the radiator distance is calculated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Algorithm of estimation of parameters of approximation for 2-D signals using prony method
abstract: An algorithm of estimation of parameters of signal decomposition of narrowband two-dimensional signals by means of Prony method is proposed. The results of statistical modeling show that the estimation error of parameters of decomposition are higher the boundary of Cramer-Rao on 30dB, which signifies about the possibility of accuracy increase of parameters of decomposition.

articleTitle: Synchronisation of oscillations of plants
abstract: Influence of external electromagnetic wave on electric signals of plants as oscillation synchronization of self-oscillator is investigated.

articleTitle: Environmentally safe radar for territorial coast waters guarding
abstract: In order to protect territorial waters from illicit fishing, waterage and other violations the over-the-horizon detection of surface objects at the 3-cm wavelengths is considered. Application of a bistatic radar with the use of an active lightship, set beyond the bounds of the horizon, was proposed.

articleTitle: Lattice modes of cylindrical dielectric resonators in plane waveguide
abstract: The results of investigations of a new material type represented by periodic structures of finite sizes, consisting of Dielectric Resonators (DR) are presented. Some of constitutive properties do not have natural analogues and have not been completely studied yet. The present report describes the findings of investigation of lattices of cylindrical DR arranged in the plane regular metallic waveguide. For determination of the main parameters such as complex resonance frequencies and amplitudes of partial DR, an electrodynamical model was used based on the supplement of perturbation theory for Maxwell equations. Obtained theoretical results demonstrate a possibility of implementation of new resonators with high Q-factor and with eigenmodes divided from the other coupling resonances by a frequency slot.

articleTitle: Differential switching radiometer
abstract: The design concept of switching radiometers for measurement of difference of weak electromagnetic radiant powers is offered. The feature of considered radiometers is the exception of a square-law detector that allows raising of accuracy of measurements.

articleTitle: On the problem of statistics of the field in the receiving aperture antennas of space radio communication systems
abstract: The analysis of statistical performances of a radiation field within the aperture of the receiving antenna taking into account influence of a turbulent aerosphere is carried out. The statistical model of a field as for a case of the non-directional irradiator in the form of a Huygens element, and for the transmitting antenna with the given aperture, is presented.

articleTitle: Efficiency of dipole radiators' vertical arrays over dissipative half-space
abstract: An underlying surface affects significantly the parameters of near-earth antenna arrays. Physical mechanisms stipulating the power losses of field of the PAA operating near the absorbing surface are considered in the report.

articleTitle: Characteristic properties of implementation of technology of wireless broadband access WiMAX in frequency bands of joint use of satellite service
abstract: Dependencies of protection ratio for receive paths of satellite ground stations at joint use of frequency bands 3,4-3,6 MHz with radio electronic means of WiMAX technology (class of emission -10M0D7W) are presented.

articleTitle: The gauging-measuring system model with controllable retransmitter structure
abstract: The model has been developed for the gauging-measuring mm-range system, which contains a retransmitter operating in near-zone remote sensing and has a controllable retransmitter structure. It has been shown that simulation allows getting the measurer signal parameters statistics for retransmitter parameters deviation from nominal values.

articleTitle: Optimization of single-frequency digital network of DVB-T standard with allowance for interference from analog and digital assignments
abstract: The method of constructing of single-frequency digital network of DVB-T standard with allowance for interference from analog and digital assignments is considered.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of microwave low-barrier Mott and Schottky detector diodes
abstract: The effect of active layer homogeneous doping in a low-barrier metal-semiconductor contact with near-surface delta-doping on current and capacitance characteristics have been investigated. Difference in characteristics of diodes with Mott and Schottky contacts develops with increasing doping, which results in partial active layer depletion. For really important thickness of an active layer in microwave diodes this concentration can be estimated as 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. Exceeding of this doping level leads to increase of reverse current, decrease current nonlinearity and growth of contact capacitance. This results in reduced volt-watt sensitivity for a detector with low-barrier Schottky diodes comparing with Mott diodes.

articleTitle: Analysis of signal transmission COFDM by means of radio-relay lines
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental investigations of signal transmission COFDM by means of radio-relay line with the use of apparatus “Evrika” in the frequency range 12,75 - 13,25 GHz are presented. It has been proved that transmission rate increased in 2 times, communication range in 2-4 times in comparison with RRL with QPSK modulation due to higher energetic and spectral characteristics of RRL with OFDM.

articleTitle: The mechanism of occurrence of error direction finding in the presence of coherent interference
abstract: The mechanism of occurrence of an error of direction finding in the presence of coherent interference is analysed. The resultant diagram is presented as a superposition of the complex diagrams formed by direct radiation and orientation diagrams formed by re-reflected radiation, and it leads to a radiation source direction displacement.

articleTitle: Excitation of cavity resonator with cappilary
abstract: The method of calculation of the area of a loop exciting a resonator with a dielectric capillary, in order to couple the resonator with a generator of electromagnetic waves is submitted. The basic characteristic of the procedure is control of the dielectric capillary placed in the resonator.

articleTitle: Limitations of diagnosis of cardiovascular system by means of representation of pulse waves in phase plane
abstract: The procedure of sphygmic diacrisis on the basis of representation of cardiac beats in the phase plane and principles of formation of the phase portrait by means of orthogonal REX-transformations are considered.

articleTitle: Multifrequency signals with golomb and costas frequency distribution
abstract: The problem of exclusion of ambiguity in range and frequency is actual for burst signals. Distribution of frequencies in multifrequency signals can be based on the theory of Galois fields of prime numbers. Present report is devoted to calculation and analysis of ambiguity functions of multifrequency bursts signals with Golomb and Costas distribution of frequencies.

articleTitle: On troposphere diagnostics of radio setting
abstract: Results of numerical analysis of space (height and distant) attenuation factor gradients of the UHF radio signal in shadow and semi-shadow areas of the radio-occultation satellite path, as a function of elevation angle placed on a satellite radio source, are given. Possibility of using height attenuation factor gradients in shadow and semi-shadow areas of the radio-occultation satellite path for radio setting monitoring of troposphere is confirmed.

articleTitle: The analysis of effective width of the radiation pattern of space communication system antennas
abstract: Formulas for the integrated distribution law of the normalized values of the envelope's square are deduced and the effective width of the radiation pattern taking into account admissible irregularity and demanded probability is defined.

articleTitle: Consistent communication theory
abstract: Physically implemented functions are used for description of a signal. Modules of spectral concentrations of a signal and basic functions coincide. Orthogonalization method of basic functions by means of determination of weight function is considered. Formulas for expression of quantity of degrees of freedom of signals and communication bandwidth are determined. The possibility of elimination of intersymbol and interchannel interference is showed.

articleTitle: FM altimeter accuracy improvement options
abstract: The problem of increasing accuracy of low altitude FM altimeter with introduction of additional “slow” modulation is analyzed. Error estimation results of using mathematical modeling of the altimeter for different modulating signal shapes are presented.

articleTitle: Sub-millimeter diodes on base of single-barrier nanostructure
abstract: A small-signal model of GaN/AlGaN/GaN nanostructural diode with electron tunnel injection through AlGaN potential barrier and transit in GaN drift layer is created considering tunnel injection delay. Parameters and impedance characteristics are determined for the sub-millimeter diodes.

articleTitle: Non-stability of symmetric state in the system of countercurrent electron streams
abstract: In the present report the increasing of space-charge density of countercurrent streams, causing losses in stability of symmetric states within the limits of two dimensional numeric model was investigated.

articleTitle: Reflector array of short-circuited coaxial-sector waveguides
abstract: Polarization patterns of a reflector array of the short-circuited coaxial-sector waveguides are researched. Frequency dependences of Stokes parameters of the reflected electromagnetic wave are presented at normal incidence of the flat linearly polarized wave on the array.

articleTitle: Analysis of the electromagnetic wave propagation in the nonlinear Bragg grating structure
abstract: The process of the electromagnetic wave propagation in the nonlinear Bragg grating system has been numerically studied. The nonlinear Kerr materials were considered. The possibility of propagation of the signal, which frequency lies within the band gap, was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo simulation of electron scattering processes by ionized impurity in conductive channels of micro- and nanodevice structures
abstract: Effective algorithm of polar angle θ selection in semiconductor ionized impurity scattering simulation according to the Ridley model is proposed. As an example, doped bulk silicon angle distribution histograms for various values of impurity concentration N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> and various values of electrons energy E are presented.

articleTitle: The bearing angle and distance of the harmonic signal radio source determination in Fresnel zone
abstract: The disadvantages of the existing phase direction-finders (PDF) with three element antenna array (AA) are shown for the case when the harmonic signal radio source (RS) is located in Fresnel zone of the AA. Determination methods of the direction-of-arrival (DOA) and distance to the harmonic signal RS located in Fresnel zone of the PDF's AA are shown.

articleTitle: Development of narrowband band-pass waveguide filters
abstract: The problems of design of microwave filters using existing CAD systems are considered.

articleTitle: Measuring system of physical properties on basis of generator with varactor frequency tuning
abstract: A new active system based on a microwave generator with varactor frequency tuning is developed, which provides improvement of reliability of a measurement process.

articleTitle: The research of gas-discharge impulse source characteristics of EHF emission for medical application
abstract: Some experimental researches of temporal dependences of current of spark discharge for the impulse source of the EHF emission are conducted. The method of biological efficiency estimation of the formed spectrum of vibrations on the basis of temporal dependence of fractal analysis parameters of current of discharge is offered.

articleTitle: The calculation of systematic error for meter of air ions concentration
abstract: Methodical error calculations of the air ions concentration measuring instrument is carried out. The majority of the commercial air ionization counters produced in our country and abroad is for domestic use and is not able to monitor the degree of ionization, which makes it unsuitable for use in medical practice. The aims of this article are description of the structure of the counter of air ions, the calculation of its precision and accuracy compared to industrially produced counters.

articleTitle: Using dispersion communication instead of correlation in the least-squares generalized method
abstract: The increasing efficiency possibility of the generalized least-squares method to estimate the signal parameters in non-Gaussian measurement errors due to the transition using correlation observations to the dispersion relations is studied.

articleTitle: Digital information transfer in analog VHF radiotelephone channels of marine and air mobile radiocommunication services
abstract: Method of digital information transmission against the background of voice signals for analog VHF radio channels of maritime and air mobile radiocommunication services is designed. The method is based on principles of digital steganography and digital watermarking technology. Experiments were conducted in the real VHF radio channel with signal processing in Matlab environment. Bit rate of 40 bit/s is achieved in 300÷3000 Hz frequency band with channel signal-to-noise ratio 20 dB.

articleTitle: Investigation of giant pulse of coherent emission by ensemble of quantum dots
abstract: The phase analysis of dynamical equations of polarization of an ensemble of quantum dots and population difference of electron levels has been carried out. Under conditions of either correlations of parameters or external permanent pumping, it has been shown that the coherent radiation occurred in the mode of giant pulse regardless of cavity detuning and coupling parameters. The comparation with the experiment data has also been carried out.

articleTitle: Response of modulation characteristics of autooscillator interacting with remote load
abstract: If an auto-oscillator (for instance, a gyrotron) is operating at an ideally matched load and the system parameters are changing, relevant variations of frequency and RF power are smooth. But even small reflection from remote load may turn the modulation response rippled.

articleTitle: The new generation of microwave near-field sensors
abstract: The article represents results of investigations and development of new principles of functioning and construction concerning microwave sensors of various physical parameters of materials and objects which have carried out for improvement its metrological characteristics and increasing the sensitivity and localization precision, for the range expansion of controlling parameters and for increasing a number of controlling parameters.

articleTitle: Filtration of output signal in UHF dual class E power amplifiers
abstract: Properties of filtration of output signal of UHF dual class E power amplifiers are investigated. The limitations of a choice of Q-factors of loaded filtering circuits in dual class E amplifiers are determined by the expressions (1)-(4). These limitations are proved by simulation results.

articleTitle: Radiometric velocity sensor of vehicle movement
abstract: Principle of construction the radiometric speed sensor of correlation type (RM SSCT) is developed. Key parameters of modulation type radiometer used in construction of the RM SSCT are defined. Mathematical model of radio thermal radiation of a terrestrial surface and objects is considered. Results of statistical modeling RM SSCT operation and results of analysis the basic characteristics of the RM SSCT for various types of objects are also illustrated.

articleTitle: On the opportunity of instability in the tubes based on a sheet beam and new class of devices with a developed interaction gap
abstract: The possibility of self-oscillation of a sheet beam transported through a drift tube with high aspect ratio is considered. Limitations for aspect ratio of the drift tube are presented. An alternative design of a multibeam tube is considered.

articleTitle: Data rates in impulse radio ultra wideband networks
abstract: Data rates in impulse radio ultra wide band networks are analyzed. It is shown that real rates are much less than those declared in publications.

articleTitle: Integral representations of electromagnetic field in boundary problems for uniaxial crystals
abstract: The generalized solution of Maxwell's equations for uniaxial crystals is obtained. Integral representations of electromagnetic field are presented by surface magnetic and electric currents.

articleTitle: Account of resulting interference attack of topical devices on receive paths of radiolocation service
abstract: An algorithm of computation of resulting interference attack of a number of topical devices on receive paths of radio devices of radiolocation service with rapid estimation of the possibility of non interference operation of given devices with already existing radio-electronic systems is offered.

articleTitle: Results of development of Wilkinson power dividers on coupled transmission lines
abstract: The results of development of Wilkinson power dividers are submitted. It is theoretically and experimentally shown, that coupled transmission lines might be used in multi-section and multi-channel power dividers.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of microwave heating and oil filtration in stratum
abstract: The mathematical model includes a system of two-dimensional interconnected equations of electromagnetic wave propagating, heat transfer and piezoconductivity. A numerical simulation of microwave heating high-viscous oil stratum was carried out with the finite element method. Optimal parameters of electromagnetic radiation source were obtained. The simulation results showed an increase of more 100% of cumulative oil production in high-viscous oil stratum.

articleTitle: Study of mechanical properties of polymeric materials modified in SHF electromagnetic field
abstract: Multiple researches conducted in order to define penetration depth of the microwave-radiation in PVC granules and film on its basis, and the mechanical properties of polymeric materials modified in the electromagnetic field, showed high effectiveness of the given method of processing. Optimum modes of modification process have been determined.

articleTitle: HF-Communication system with return engineering satellite communication channel
abstract: The method of capacity growth of HF-communication system due to the use of information about parameters of the communication channel gained through the high-speed follow-up channel is considered. In the serial modem the predistortions of transmitted signals is used. In OFDM modem the fast adaptation of signal parameters is applied.

articleTitle: UHF dual class E amplifier with subsequent inductance and filter resonant circuit in switch
abstract: The dual class E amplifier with subsequent inductance and filter resonant circuit in switch is presented. The values of elements of load network of amplifier are determined. A design of output transmission-lines of the amplifier is also presented. The amplifier is proved to operate with good accuracy.

articleTitle: Efficiency of narrow band Doppler selection of the signal in presence of the scattering from the SEA
abstract: Efficiency of narrow-band Doppler selections has been considered. Characteristics of detectors with adaptation of a threshold and rank at various polarizations of radiation and reception are estimated.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic oscillations of grains of cereal
abstract: The method of calculation of own frequencies of electromagnetic oscillations of grains of cereal is developed. It is based on representation of grain in the form of three-layer spheroidal dielectric resonator.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistance of metallic single-wall carbon nanotubes
abstract: The physico-mathematical model of electron transfer in metallic single-wall carbon nanotubes in the magnetic field is developed. The dependencies of ratio of magnetoresistance of nanotubes versus intrinsic resistance on induction of constant and uniform transverse magnetic fields applied to nanotubes are calculated.

articleTitle: Criteria of nominal interference attack on receive paths of radio devices in operation mode on combined frequency bands with radio devices of other services
abstract: It is offered to use, as a criterion of interference attack on receive paths of radio devices of radar, ratio of compression of detection area. Basic relations between ratio of compression and a nominal level of interference attack on a receiver input are determined.

articleTitle: Increasing the energy efficiency of spatial tracking for priory unknown wideband signals by eigenvector following method
abstract: A new method of amplitude-phase distribution estimation for multielement antenna array is proposed after solving the optimization task and it is analyzed. It is based on main eigenvector calculation for spatial correlation matrix. Its application allows increasing the efficiency of both classic and “superresolution” methods of spatial tracking for priory unknown wideband signals.

articleTitle: Output power stabilization of limiting amplifiers in mixed and switched modes of operation
abstract: The method of output power stabilization of limiting amplifiers in mixed and switched operation modes is presented. By means of this method the dual class E amplifier with output power from 6.1 to 6.4 W was designed at variations of input power and temperature.

articleTitle: Pulsed microwave signals passing through the signal-to-noise enhancer based on ferromagnetic film (Model and experiment)
abstract: A simple two-level model of the microwave signal-to-noise enhancer (SNE) was introduced. A fairly accurate description both of the sinusoidal and pulsed microwave signals passing through the system was obtained by means of numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Displacement current influence on frequency characteristics and Schottky FET firmness
abstract: Problems of a displacement current account and its influence on frequency characteristics and electrothermal firmness of GaAs Schottky FET are considered. The numerical calculation was carried out in kinetic approach by means of a large particles approach. The analysis of a displacement current influence on the frequency characteristic and Wunsh-Bell criteria dependence for Schottky FET is resulted.

articleTitle: Estimation of influence of irregularity of spatial topology of cellular communication systems with code division of channels on quality of coverage area
abstract: The influence of the irregularity of spatial topology of cellular communication network of standard IS-95 is considered. The use of the sector site with repetition of frequency in the sectors is optimum for communication networks with code division of channels.

articleTitle: Analysis of MIMO based radio access systems using second-order channel statistics
abstract: Application of second-order statistics of variable fading channels (average level crossing rate and average fade duration) for estimation of time behavior of MIMO-system characteristics is investigated. Mathematical expressions of these statistical parameters for MIMO-system are derived. Verification of the results is conducted using numerical modeling.

articleTitle: Electrically-tunable MM-wave waveguide phase shifter based on hexaferrite-piezoelectric layered structure
abstract: A new class of electrically tunable mm-wave signal processing devices based on a layered hexaferrite-piezoelectric structure is proposed. Experimental data and theoretical calculation are considered.

articleTitle: UHF dual class E amplifier with subsequent inductance and resistive losses in switch
abstract: The dual class e amplifier with subsequent inductance and resistive losses in switch is presented. The efficiency, maximum frequency and optimum values of elements of load network of amplifier are determined. The calculated values and parameters are proved by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Estimation of wireless ad HOC network connectivity
abstract: To quantify the connectivity of wireless ad hoc networks, proposed vector criterion, which includes a set of information and operational parameters of the network and their limitations. Proposed four expressions to quantify the degree of wireless ad hoc networks connectivity, depending on the intended telecommunications tasks.

articleTitle: Short electromagnetic pulse propagation in the turbid medium
abstract: The propagation of the short electromagnetic pulse in the turbid medium is studied on the basis of equivalence of the radiative transfer theory and coherence functions approach. It is shown that traditional Markovian approximation suffers from the systematic error due to neglected propagation path length distribution. The corrected solution of the problem is derived and analyzed.

articleTitle: Information sensors of near-field zone of radio-technical systems of focusing of microwave energy
abstract: The measuring of parameters of the wavefront at any distance from the emission source (antenna system) on the basis of general principles of radio physics and optics led to the appearance of new radio-technical systems with wide functional capabilities for a solution of a number of applications and special problems.

articleTitle: Low-frequency arc arrays
abstract: The arc antenna array for 3-30 MHz frequency band has been designed.

articleTitle: Analysis of H-shaped slot resonators in ground plane of microstrip line
abstract: The algorithm of computation of scattering matrix on discontinuity in the ground plane of the microstrip line in the form of H-shaped slot resonator has been obtained. The calculation results of resonance frequencies of microstrip resonator with discontinuity determined from the solution of “electric” and “magnetic” boundary problems are presented. The scattering characteristics of the periodic structures formed by the finite number of cells in the frequency band 2-8 GHz are given.

articleTitle: Computational algorithm of control signal of channel of notching of adaptive multichannel system of transfer of acoustic signals
abstract: Ccomputational algorithms of control signals of channel of notching of adaptive multichannel system of transfer of acoustic signals, which is operated at influence of narrow-band interference, are investigated.

articleTitle: Measurement accuracy increase for nanodimensional systems parameters in near-field microwave microscopes
abstract: The new approached method of reflection factor calculation for near-field microwave microscope is offered, it allows raising measurement accuracy of nanodimensional systems parameters.

articleTitle: Wavelet transform usage for pulse wave digital analisys
abstract: The method of processing pulse signal to liberate it from the noise component based on the discrete wavelet transform is presented. The accuracy of the method, depending on the level of noise for different types of analyzing wavelets, is carried out. It is shown that the method of discrete wavelet transform is not inferior to other methods for solving the problem of eliminating noise components, at the same time, it has several advantages.

articleTitle: Absorption of visible and infrared radiation in nanostrucures with energy profile of irregular shape
abstract: The processes of absorption of radiation of visible and infrared bands in the nanostructure, energy profile of which consists of the rectangular quantum well and the rectangular cavity in its central part, are considered. The possibility of intensification of absorption lines at the expense of variation of technological parameters at the stage of the constructional design and manufacturing is considered.

articleTitle: Method of estimating effective length of the meteor trail
abstract: The method for estimating the effective length of the meteor trail, along which the electron line density provides an opportunity for organization of communication with the given parameters of communication system.

articleTitle: Spurious resonances in electrodynamics problems on the waveguide discontinues
abstract: It is shown, that the problem of existence of spurious resonances in tasks of diffraction waveguide waves on various discontinues is stipulated by incorrect representation of matrix elements of the linear algebraic equations system (SLAE). This mistake can be rather simply corrected due to correct representation of SLAE matrix elements which has no singularities. The efficiency of such approach is shown by results of numerical calculations.

articleTitle: Semiconductor discrete phase shifters for semiactive S-band array transceivers of up to 2 kW peak power
abstract: Three kinds of pin-diode discrete phase shifter for semi-active s-band array transceivers of up to 2 kW peak power design are presented. The results of modeling of electric and thermodynamic loadings in used silicon pin-diodes and in structural components in comparison with measured data are shown.

articleTitle: Wireless mesh network throughput estimation vs. node transmitter power
abstract: The model of a wireless network with competitive access to the shared environment of information transfer is created. Throughput for various powers of transmitters and data rate estimations are acquired for simulated network.

articleTitle: Grain flow humidity microwave probe
abstract: Development of grain flow humidity microwave resonant probe is presented. Humidity is estimated at resonant frequency and attenuation measurements. The probe operates in 3.2 to 3.7 GHz band and provides grain flow humidity measurement from 5% to 20% with ±0.1 % to ±0.3% accuracy.

articleTitle: Methods of levels detection of harmonic components of transistor oscillators
abstract: Using a method of slowly varying amplitudes the calculation of levels of harmonic components of SHF microwaves of the transistor oscillator is carried out. It is shown, that their values are determined not only by elements of the circuit of the generator and amplitude of the basic fluctuation, but also substantially by nonlinearity of the characteristics in the field of a working point. For reduction of levels of harmonic components under adjustment of generators, as a criterion of characteristic nonlinearity estimation, it is offered to use change of size of a constant component of a target current of the transistor in case of influence of SHF signal.

articleTitle: Multiplier optimization for two random band-pass signals
abstract: A consistent theory of random signal multiplication based on a nonlinear non-inertial element is developed. An optimal spectral band for signal conversion to secondary heterodyne band was chosen. An optimal power of noise heterodyne is calculated.

articleTitle: Mechanism of estimation for integrated rating using web sources
abstract: The paper reviews the approach for integrated rating extraction. This approach is based on using search engine API and web scraping mechanisms. The computational formula for integrated rating calculation is proposed.

articleTitle: SHF channels noise compensation
abstract: The noise compensation method, which is applicable in high frequency systems, is presented. Noise compensation is realized by using of both channels of polar modulated signals.

articleTitle: Polarization properties of kaleidoscopic-type wave bunch splitter
abstract: Polarization properties of kaleidoscopic-type wave bunch splitter are investigated. Several possible variants of multiple reflections of linearly polarized wave bunches are considered. Linear to circular polarization conversion and polarization plane rotation conditions are determined.

articleTitle: Analysis of phase remote atmospheric air humidity measurement methods
abstract: This paper suggests double-frequency phase remote atmospheric air humidity measurement methods which can offer an alternative for amplitude methods. Certain small distinctions in sound velocities under condition of dispersion can be discovered by measuring the difference of phases between Doppler change frequencies of accepted signals frequencies.

articleTitle: Neural technology application in radio navigation of movable objects
abstract: This article deals with solutions of base problems of strapdown inertial systems as a main component of integrated inertial-satellite systems of radio navigation of movable objects by means of neural algorithms. Methods of automatical correction norm of solution of parametric Rydberg-Hamilton kinematical equations have been approved. Foundation basis for hardware realization using Nvidia central processing unit based system has been prepared.

articleTitle: Efficiency of nonlinear scheme of compromises for tracking mode of multifunctional radar station
abstract: Analytical expressions have been obtained and estimation of efficiency of application of quality index formed on the basis of the nonlinear scheme of compromises for control of the tracking mode of the multifunctional radar station has been conducted. It is shown that supplement of performance index in the process of development of methods and control algorithms of the tracking mode allows raising of efficiency of embodiment of multifunctional radar station (MF RS) as information subsystem of air defense missile system (ADMS).

articleTitle: Experimental investigations of coordinate-connected arrays on multilayer printed boards
abstract: The experimental results of investigation of coordinated-connected arrays with the use of multilayer printed boards are submitted. The obtained results indicate isolation of more than 80 dB.

articleTitle: Software module for estimation of quality of color television images
abstract: The results of development of software module designed for the use in the discipline Fundamentals of television and study of basic principles of formation of color signals in TV and techniques estimating the quality of color television images with traditional means of colorimetry are presented.

articleTitle: Complex ecological monitoring of local water areas
abstract: The complex method of the ecological monitoring of local water areas by using of non-space facilities of the remote sensing (RS) of near radio-location (RL) in combination with contact ones is offered.

articleTitle: Influence of parameters of paths on measurement results of characteristics of radio-electronic devices
abstract: A methodology of estimation of influence of parameters of a path on the results of measurements of characteristics of radio-electronic devices is proposed. The procedure is based on the randomization of the module and phase of electrical impedances of the path given to the inputs/outputs of the devices, and the use of statistical methods in the course of calculation of parameters.

articleTitle: Experimental research and simulation of microwave oscillator based on structure of static inductance transistor with negative resistance
abstract: The experimental research of characteristics of the microwave oscillator based on the structure of static inductance transistor has been carried out and the model of its static and dynamic current-voltage characteristics has been improved. The results of the experimental research show that oscillating frequency changes from 770 to 900MHz, amplitude of generate oscillations changes from 5 to 22 V, average power of oscillations is 96mW, coefficient of efficiency is 80–85% when supply voltage variation is from 9 to 30 V. Calculation of characteristics by means of the simplified charge model of the structure of static inductance transistor gives quite accurate description of characteristics of the active element of the oscillator.

articleTitle: Interaction of vertically oriented carbon nanotubes in solid monolith with millimeter waves
abstract: The interaction of millimeter-wave radiation (MWR) with vertically oriented carbon nanotubes (CNT) in solid monolith has been investigated. CNT demonstrated a high-efficiency electromagnetic shielding due to high conductivity of CNT and iron-containing filling compound. The shielding efficiency and reflection loss depending on CNT orientation have been measured in a rectangular waveguide. The resonant absorption of millimeter waves has been revealed at the orthogonal CNT orientation with respect to MWR of electric field in the waveguide.

articleTitle: Unified communications in universities information environments
abstract: Unified Communications is the integration of real-time communication services, such as: instant messaging, presence indication, standard telephony, IP-telephony, video conferencing and off-line services of communication (voice mail, e-mail and SMS). The report will examine the basic characteristics of unified communications systems, their benefits, layered structure, as well as the proposed solution for implementation on the example of the existing information structure.

articleTitle: Microstrip based bandpass filters design
abstract: The construction principle of modified hairpin bandpass filters in microwave ranges is designed. It is shown, that amplitude-frequency characteristics of the proposed filters have more high steepness decline and best suppression in band of the barrier in comparison with its prototype. These filters are easy in fabrication and adjustment.

articleTitle: Wireless system of subscriber access to information resources
abstract: In the present work the technical solution of a problem of wireless access to the information resources over the territory of Ukraine, including the rural areas. The area of coverage consists of two areas. The first area operates in the center of the region (urban and marginal development) and data transmission is supported by the channels of wireless access with multi-frequency modulation. The service zone of rural areas includes channels with single-frequency modulation. The offered technical solution allows covering of basic services of communication of data and digital television over the territory of Ukraine. The system might be executed in different configurations depending on the claimed services in the certain region.

articleTitle: Arrangement of technological measurements of antennas parameteres under working area conditions
abstract: The article is about technological measurements during large-scale antenna production. It is suggested to measure only one antenna sample in anechoic chamber and do the rest measurements right in a production room.

articleTitle: Shielding effectiveness of single-and double-layered liquid-containing flexible shields based on textile materials with gel-powder fillers
abstract: We present experimental results of reflection and transmission coefficients for single- and double-layered liquid-containing flexible shields based on textile materials with gel-powder fillers.

articleTitle: New design of rectangular waveguide bends in E-plane under arbitrary angles
abstract: New constructions of rectangular waveguide bend in E-plane under arbitrary angles, which are simpler for manufacturing, are presented. Optimal dimensions of matching elements for reflection coefficient reducing are determined. Simulation and measuring results are represented.

articleTitle: Estimation of proximity effect of polyethyleneglycol at e-beam polymerization for realization of nanoscale bioactive hydrogels
abstract: Ability of applying of electron scanning microscope for production of nanoscale bioactive structures by means of e-beam polymerization of polyethyleneglycol, placed on the silicon substrate. Resolution capability of gel structure depends on proximity effect of an electron beam. And this effect must be analyzed. For calculation of resolution capability computations of proximity effect through analytical model of Boltzmann kinetic equation, joining small-angle and diffuse approximations.

articleTitle: To the anniversary of spouses Alybiny
abstract: DIscusses the anniversary of spouses Alybiny.

articleTitle: Research of optical, magneto-optical properties and structural phase state of films systems based on Cr and Fe
abstract: The optical, magneto-optical properties and structural phase state were researched in the film systems based on Cr, Fe.

articleTitle: No title
abstract: A set of medical optoelectronic equipment, designed in order to perform medical procedures with new-born children such as medical examination, diagnostic routine, sanitation, medicine treatment, light therapy, massage and other physiotherapeutic procedures, is presented. The apparatus includes the metal support with a cradle for a baby, a multirange optical module, a temperature sensor, a micro-controller, a device of emergency alarm. The equipment has passed the sanitary-hygienic tests and has been implemented into the medical practice in a large number of Belarusian medical institutions.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling of flat superlens
abstract: In this work we present results of numerical modeling based on Pocklington integral equation of flat superlenses composed of helixes and linear half-wave pieces as well as of helical coils facing in different direction. The resolution of lenses was determined. Experimental results, which confirm the mathematical model to be appropriate, are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave narrow band filters
abstract: For the problem solution of electromagnetic compatibility and information channels packaging of satellite and TV communications in microwave bands the original narrow-band filters based on high waveguide-dielectric resonators with anisotropic materials have been created. The filters are a section of a cut-off waveguide with flanges which contains one or several dielectric inserts completely filling a resonator along a narrow waveguide wall and partially along a wide wall.

articleTitle: Transition model between technologies in mobile SDR-networks
abstract: The mobile network based on SDR demands special methods of the software updating, such as methods of a DB adapted to SDR. This paper represents the approach to updating the software of SDR systems.

articleTitle: Experimental research of relative dielectric constant of dielectric substrates by microwave resonant method
abstract: Experimental investigations of values of relative dielectric constant of “polykor” substrates, which are widely used in designing of various microwave devices, are held. The difference between experimental results and rated values is considered.

articleTitle: Electron drift velocity in PHEMT
abstract: The temperature dependence of drift velocity-field characteristics of two-dimensional electron gas in AlGaAs/InGaAs Pseudomorphic High Electron Mobility Transistor is determined. The saturation drift velocity in AlGaAs/InGaAs quantum well reduces from 1.55·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> to 1.3·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> cm/sec in a temperature range from 200 to 400K.

articleTitle: Template matching estimation of radioholographic test objects parameters by means of minimum-phase method
abstract: A minimum-phase method (MPM) is approved on a set of radioholographic test objects. Objects' parameters estimations' classification characteristics, their bias and variance as the function of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) are obtained.

articleTitle: Estimation of overheating of p-n junction and its effect on degradation of silicon high-power pulse impatt diodes
abstract: The estimation of thermal limitations for pulse operation mode in the 8 mm-wave band of double-drift impact avalanche and transit-time (IMPATT) diodes with microwave power ≥20 W. It is shown that at pulse duration of 300 ns and amplitude of 11.3–15 A; overheating of p-n junction is 270–430 °C. The boundary value of temperature of p-n junction at which IMPATT diode degradation begins is found to be 350 °C.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a circular antenna array on a conducting conical surface to attain omni-directional pattern
abstract: The method of synthesis is presented for omni-directional microstrip ring antenna array (RAA) arranged on a conducting conical surface.

articleTitle: High-frequency hysteresis in uniaxial hexaferrites
abstract: Features of behaviour of a high-frequency hysteresis loop depending on the value of magnetisation field are experimentally investigated. Mechanisms for explanation of this phenomenon are offered.

articleTitle: Built-in test systems of active phased-array antennas
abstract: In the active phased array antennas, transmit and receive functions are distributed over the aperture using transmit and receive (T/R) modules. Active phased arrays are typically calibrated in the near-field antenna range on a factory. The performance of the active phased array antennas degrades over the course of time due to the changes in the characteristics of active devices and it requires recalibration in the field. The conditions and methods required for the measurements of the active phased-array antennas (APAA), the initial alignment, the automatic diagnostics and performance monitoring are described. Special attention is given to the constructive peculiarities of APAA and restrictions of measurements. A numerical model of a process of performance monitoring has been developed and a large number of test cases examined in order to isolate and characterize errors commonly occured in the built-in performance-monitoring systems (BPMS). The test methods used for ApAA transmit or receive performance testing must be analyzed separately. During the alignment and testing of APAA, especially with high-power transmitting potential, it is necessary to fulfill some special requirements of measurement facilities and analytical software that are not encountered in other areas of applications of antenna measurements. Either simulation or measurement results are presented to demonstrate the utility of the proposed measuring and monitoring techniques. Future directions of investigation of application of BPMS are highlighted.

articleTitle: Design of the ultrawideband 12,05–37,50 GHz test antenna
abstract: The results of design of measuring antenna for frequency range 12.05–37.50 GHz are presented. The antenna is intended for measuring of power flow density of electromagnetic field, parameters of antenna assemblies, parameters of electromagnetic compatibility of radioelectronic facilities and excitation of EM field with defined power flow density. Wide frequency band, high technical performance and ambient capability within severe environmental withstand of −50° C … +60 C nominate this antenna as the best one inside the corresponding class of antennas. The antenna type is named as the ⊓6–66.

articleTitle: Orotrons of frequency range 140–300 GHz
abstract: Experimental investigation of two embodiments of orotrons in frequency range 140GHz–300GHz was carried out. The electrodynamic system is designed on the basis of an open resonator, including one plane mirror where double-row periodic structure (DRPS) is installed and focusing mirrors of two types — spherocylinder and multifocal spherical mirror. The longitudinal axis of spherocylinder is parallel to the axis of symmetry of DRPS. The multifocal mirror is formed by some (3 or 4) crossed spherical surfaces with general plane of symmetry along the interaction space of the device. The comparative analysis of output parameters of orotrons with multifocal and spherocylindrical mirrors shows that the correct choice of their geometries efficiently increases interaction length and correspondingly reduces start current value in the orotron.

articleTitle: Multi-channel ground penetrating radar: Hardware and software
abstract: Current state of our multi-channel GPR elaboration is presented. GPR is designed for diagnostics of roads' coating, detection and recovery of subsurface infrastructure in soil down to 1.2 meters depth. Multi-channel architecture allows inspecting 1-m width strip of ground surface simultaneously. Designed GPR parameters, its hardware and software are discussed. 3D images of subsurface objects formed by GPR as well as results of objects geometry restoration are presented. Dedicated software enables estimating the geometry and electro-physical parameters of subsurface volume and objects inside of it. For this, so-called Computational diagnostics method, which is based on reverse problem solution, is implemented.

articleTitle: To 80-year anniversary of Professor Pimenov Yury Vadimovich
abstract: DIscusses the 80-year anniversary of Professor Pimenov Yury Vadimovich.

articleTitle: Modeling of electron transport in resonant-tunneling heterostructures on a base of wide bandgap gallium nitride's combinations
abstract: Numerical method for calculation of electron transport in GaN/AlGaN resonant-tunneling heterostructures is developed. It has been shown with using this method that the external electric field symmetrizes the potential profile of resonant-tunneling diode and increases a value of transparency coefficient's maximum.

articleTitle: Frequency dependences of NDC for nitride compound calculated by Monte-Carlo techniques
abstract: The oscillation efficiency of nitride diodes operating in limitation of accumulation of the space charge (LSA) in the wide taraherz frequency range has been investigated. The maximal frequencies correspond to the existing regions of negative differential conductivity (NDP) 600 GHz for InN 800 GHz for GaN and 1200 GHz for AlN are showed.

articleTitle: On the field of antenna radiation circular the polarization
abstract: The article concerns submission of antenna radiation field in a circular polarization basis. A block diagram of measuring system for the investigation of amplitude and polarization directional diagrams is presented.

articleTitle: Spectrum analysis of Lyapunov exponents for models of electron systems
abstract: Method of calculation of spectrum of Lyapunov exponents for electron systems has been proposed. Method approvement was carried out on the basis of Pierce diode - standard beam-plasma system, which allows performing of chaotic dynamics.

articleTitle: Control mode of network resources in multiservice telecommunication systems on basis of distributed system of agents
abstract: A work is devoted to the solution of an actual scientific problem which consists in development and improvement of control methods of the network resources in TCS as well as their dynamic models constructed on the basis of imitating facility of E-networks. It provides to support the required performance.

articleTitle: Composite materials on basis of NiFe2O4 nanoparticles and polyethylene matrix
abstract: The composite materials on the basis of NiFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> nanoparticles and polyethylene matrix have been synthesized. The concentration dependences of volume resistivity εV, permittivity ε, saturation magnetization σS and reflection and attenuation factors have been investigated. It has been determined that percolation threshold in these materials had been located at the concentration interval 20...30 of weight %. It has been shown that the composites on the basis of NiFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> nanoparticles and polyethylene matrix might be used as the components of gradient radio absorbing coatings.

articleTitle: Magnetic field influence on detection properties of planar microwave diodes on the base of modulation doped semiconductor structures
abstract: Detection properties of planar microwave diodes have been investigated under the action of external magnetic field at room temperature. The diodes were fabricated from modulation doped semiconductor structures having planar asymmetrically and symmetrically narrowed n-n+ junctions. Their operation is based on non-homogeneous carrier heating by a microwave electric field. Frequency dependence of the detected voltage confirmed presence of rectification of microwave currents in the signal formation. Experimental investigations revealed that voltage sensitivity of the diodes was conditioned by the external magnetic field. Sensitivity changes are explained as a result of the magnetic field influence on rectification of microwave currents as well as taking into account the influence of magnetoresistance effect on the formation of the detected voltage. The magnetoresistance is manifested more strongly, when magnetic field is perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the diode owing to more influence of Lorentz force. Demonstration of magnetoresistance at magnetic field, which is parallel the diode axis, is explained by the fact, that currents in the asymmetrically necked diode make a non-zero angle with lines of electric and magnetic fields owing to widening of n field of n-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> junction. When this angle between lines of electrical and magnetic fields decreases, that occurs in case of the symmetrically necked diode, the more weak averaged relative voltage sensitivity of diodes is experimentally observed.

articleTitle: Computation of partitioning of coherent pulse group that minimizes time of estimation of higher derivatives of Doppler-beat frequency
abstract: The maximally realistic method of estimation of higher derivatives of Doppler frequency on the basis of coherent pulse group due to its partitioning has been developed. Dependencies of time of optimization and probability of anomalous errors as functions of a number of fragments, parameters of the pulse group and signal-to-noise ratio have been obtained. The optimal number of fragments has been found. The obtained results have been verified with the simulated data.

articleTitle: Base elements of integrated circuits of microwave range
abstract: The junctions are the basic elements of the fundamental line and functional units of microwave ranges. In the paper the analysis of the junctions using the numerical grid method was made. The received results permitted to expand our knowledge about physics and parameters of the junctions.

articleTitle: The microwave transmitting module for Doppler navigator equipment (DISD — FG) OF "Phobos — Grunt" program
abstract: The results of the development of the transmitting module M45224 of Doppler speed and range measuring device (DISD) are presented. This module is designed to work in the ASC “Phobos-Grunt” movement measuring lander during the final approach and landing segments. M45224 Transmitter Module is designed by FSUC “Istok” for Doppler velocity and range measuring device (DISD). It consists of two identical solid-state microwave generators (main and backup) with a frequency modulation and microwave radio frequency unit, which includes a switch for five outputs-channels (signals from four channels are received at the antenna, while the fifth one is a control channel, and a signal from this channel is given to the receiving module), a power combiner and a directional power coupler for the heterodyne signal receiver formation. The module is intended to work in ASC “Phobos-Grunt” spacecraft for the lender movement measuring on segments of the final approach and landing on Phobos.

articleTitle: Spectral-polarizing observations of maser sources in line of aqueous vapor on wave 1.35 CM with RT-22 crimean astrophysical observatory
abstract: The spectral-polirimetric receiver based on Fourier spectrum analyzer with frequency resolution 0.5 kHz for systematic and comprehensive investigations of the areas of astration in the line of water vapor at wavelength 1.35 cm has been developed and put into operation. In the mode of single antenna spectral observations of the sources of maser emission has been conducted.

articleTitle: Radiophysics features of agrarian reference sites at base subsatellite landfill "SKRIPAI"
abstract: A complex of agrarian reference sites was organized. It serves for the operational calibration of space-based remote sensing sensors of different ranges, validation and verification obtained of its data. The second class weather station is located at the complex. A required number of reference points and calibration for all ranges, in particular, for service sAr, is provided. We give radiophysical characteristics of reference sites in the millimeter and centimeter wavelengths in relation to microclimatic data and the parameters of the infrastructure of agricultural vegetation.

articleTitle: Calibrated twin-detector slotted-guide converter for complex reflectance factor gage
abstract: The model-building technique of complex reflectance factor gage based on a calibrated twin-detector slotted-guide converter is suggested. A testing method of complex reflectance factor of working generator output and elimination of its influence to measuring results are considered.

articleTitle: The robust adaptive signal processing in correlated noise
abstract: A new approach is considered for solving the problem of spatiotemporal signal processing in adaptive antenna arrays in conditions intensive correlated noise processes. The method of synthesis of robust algorithms is based on the game-theoretical principle of searching a minimum of the root-mean-square error that characterizes quality of received estimations of the existential spectra. The signal processing algorithms, constructed on this principle, relate to the class of minimax algorithms being invariant with respect to the prior uncertainty concerning noise distributions.

articleTitle: Advertisement
abstract: The use of Independent Component Discriminant Analysis (ICDA) for remote sensing classification is proposed. ICDA is a non-parametric method for discriminant analysis based on the application of a Bayesian classification rule on a signal composed by independent components. The method is based on the use of Independent Component Analysis (ICA) to choose a transform matrix so that the transformed components are as independent as possible. Then, a non parametric estimation of the density function is computed for each independent component. Finally, the Bayes rule is applied for classification assignment. The obtained results are compared with one of the most used classifier of hyperspectral images (Support Vector Machine) and show the comparative effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Innovations in communication technologies development on the Black Sea Fleet (1993–2002)
abstract: The paper is prepared by director of Signals division of the Black Sea Fleet (1991–2002), rear admiral, chevalier Zinur Lyapin. Described in the paper is the hard period for signals division of the Black Sea Fleet, which has followed after USSR breakup, as well as innovations introduced into communication technology: wireless telephone, paging, trunking and satellite communication systems.

articleTitle: Sea tests of primal national systems of radio detection and their tactical deployment in defense of sevastopol 1941–1942 (to 65 anniversary of victory)
abstract: Data of sea tests of the first systems of radio detection in September-November of 1939 in the Black Sea near Sevastopol are presented and report on their tactical deployment on the basis of memoirs of a defender of Sevastopol, commanding officer of air defense battery, Ye. A. Ignatovich (22.10.1916-23.08.2000) is submitted. Short summary about the author of memoirs is given.

articleTitle: Simulation of transfer processes in solid-state heterojunction structures with space-charge waves
abstract: On the basis of a method of statistical modeling investigations of basic mechanisms of dispersion in semiconductor heterostructures and basic characteristics of a physical process of carrier transfer in a mode with occurrence of plasma waves are carried out. Novelty consists in statistical modeling and self-co-ordinated solution of Schroedinger equation. It all allows revealing of basic physical mechanisms, determining the increase of propagation velocity of plasma waves, and defining of requirements of a choice of electrophysical parameters of heterostructures for production of oscillations in the millimetric range.

articleTitle: Application of autoemitters for excitation of secondary emission in pulsed cold-cathode magnetrons
abstract: The magnetron with side auxiliary thermionic cathode and basic cold second-emission cathode having thin circular ribs on the surface is experimentally investigated. It is shown that such device after activation might operate for a long period of time at the out-of-work heating. Stability of functioning degrades at the increase of pulsewidth and duty ratio.

articleTitle: Autodyne sensors for railway crossings
abstract: The autodyne sensor description on Gunn diode of 8-mm wave-length intended for detection of path occupation and the caps of the obstacle device for transport vehicles at guarded and non-guarded railway crossings is discussed.

articleTitle: Limitations of the use of SDR in mobile networks
abstract: Creation of device, which can work with mobile networks, is possible using several technologies. A decision can be using of the systems with the program signal processing. But application of SDR requires modernization of base station and presence of the special technologies. Thus it is required to take into account some possible limitations considered in this work.

articleTitle: Microwave properties of planar tunable ferroelectric (Ba, Sr)TiO3 capacitors depending on component composition
abstract: Microwave properties of planar tunable capacitors based on (Ba, Sr)TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ferroelectric films of different compositions have been investigated. The composition of ferroelectric films with the best combination of high tunability and low losses for microwave applications has been determined.

articleTitle: The basic aspects of the general theory of scanning microwave microscopy
abstract: The numerical modeling of electrodynamics of interaction of the coaxial resonator microprobe with dielectric and semiconductor objects allowed ascertaining some dependence of signal parameters of primary transformation of the information on the geometry of probe aperture and electrophysical parameters of an object. Numerical-analytical and experimental research after detector transformation of signals have determined a general theoretical aspects of various ways of this stage of signal forming. The preconditions of forming of the general theory of SMM are created.

articleTitle: Problems and technical aspects of creation of devices for the control and measuring parameters of wireless systems
abstract: The basic problems and problems of technical realization of the universal multipurpose device - a radio tester are considered. Experimental researches of a breadboard model of a radio tester have shown that for expansion of a dynamic range of the receiver and reception of phase noise a heterodyne at 100dB/Hz level on distance 10 KHz from carrier frequency use of two-loopback system PLL is necessary. In a digital part of a radio tester a quadrature demodulator on digital receiver AD6655 is used for digital filtration in a range of frequencies from 20 MHz to 1MHz with signal suppression in Nyquist strip to 100 dB.

articleTitle: Model of radar scattering cross-section of breakdown of sea wind waves
abstract: Radar backscattering of breakdown of sea wind waves is investigated in the field conditions using Ka-band continuous wave radar (37.5 GHz) and video imaging of radar footprint. The linear relationship between wave radar cross-section (RCS) of breakdown of waves and its length at high incidence angles is revealed. The model of whitecap RCS based on spray scattering is proposed for investigation of scattering at high incidence angles. It is shown that composite model of quasi-specular reflection and spray scattering is in good agreement with field data at moderate and high incidence angles.

articleTitle: Electronic properties of WO3 quantum films
abstract: By ab initio calculations we show that quantum confinement effects do not affect the energy band gap in the quantum films of WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thicker than 1.5 nm. We have also revealed that states of the surface atoms stabilize the band-gap edges.

articleTitle: Experimental study of phenomenon of coherence resonance in klystron active oscillators with delayed feedback
abstract: Results of experimental investigation of phenomenon of coherence resonance in klystron active oscillators with delayed feedback are given.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of germanium driving back from germanium-silicate glass formed in the process of oxidation of the germanium-doped polycrystalline silikon films
abstract: It is determined that the content of Ge in the volume of germanium-silicate glass (GSG) influences density of nanocrystalline grains. It is ascertained that germanium atoms are unevenly distributing between separate nanoclusters as well as in the limits of one cluster. The size and density of germanium nanoclusters may be independently checked by the way of changing of germanium content in the composition of GSG, by the medium, temperature and by the heat treatment.

articleTitle: Epitaxial growth of column-like nanostructures InGaN on Si in poromeric anodic alumina
abstract: Method of formation of regular PAA without a barrier layer in the process of anodizing of Al-film on n-type Si has been developed. Semiconductor InGaN-structures were selectively grown in modified PAA-template by MO VPE. Formed self-organized nanostructures InGaN have nonpolar crystallographic α-orientation. Investigations of luminescent properties and analysis of the spectral characteristics have been performed.

articleTitle: Biological properties of water after radiation of GSM mobile phone
abstract: The bottled drinking water exposed by the radiation mobile phone was used for watering of wheat grains. The number of shoots increased considerably and they were better developed. The polyethylene film shielded and exposed water influenced on the number of shoots and their growth negatively.

articleTitle: Method of microwave scanning tomography of electrical properties of semiconductors
abstract: The technique of microwave diagnostics of semiconductors with arbitrary distribution of electrical properties in depth has been developed. It has been proposed to conduct the scanning of the value of the air gap between the resonator sensor and the surface of the semiconductor. The one-dimensional reconstruction algorithm of distribution of electrical properties of the semi-conductor has been generated. It consists of solution of the integral equation for the intermediate function, which completely characterizes the properties of the object, and step-by-step algorithm for solution of the ill-posed inverse problem.

articleTitle: 50-Year anniversary of radioengineering and telecommunications department, SevNTU. radioengineering in sevastopol affiliation of Odessa Polytechnical Institute (1960–1963)
abstract: Based on analysis of archival materials, considered is initial period of radioengineering development in Sevastopol National Technical University, which corresponds to the period of affiliation of Odessa Polytechnical Institute (1960-1963). The data regarding subjects and personalia (Dot-senko A. I., Fish M. L., Derkach I. N., Buryanov P. D., Vinogra-dova V. S., Kononov B. V., Maraktanov V. A., Misan A. N., Svir' V. Ya., Khomenko N. Ye.) are presented.

articleTitle: Aspects of basic network modernization for interworking with devices based on SDR
abstract: Different aspects of basic network modernization for interworking with devices and nodes based on SDR were considered in the report and methods of networks modernization, which can be used in practice, were proposed.

articleTitle: Synchronization of mobile communication base stations in use of IP/MPLS network for broadcast of timing signals
abstract: The present paper concerns basic principles of the time synchronization for Base stations including using IP/MPLS network for broadcast of timing signals on PTP protocol.

articleTitle: Complex dielectric permittivity of composites based on dielectric matrixes with inclusions of carbon nanotubes
abstract: The experimental research of temperature dependence of multilayered carbon nanotubes conductivity (MCNT) included as a component of epoxy resin composites have been performed at the frequency band from 0.1 to 6 GHz. Two mechanisms with different activation energy influence on the temperature dependence of carbon nanotubes conductivity.

articleTitle: On a method of resonance microstrip antenna termostabilization
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental researches of possibilities of termostabilization of resonance microstrip antennas of UHF are presented using double-layer dielectric plates with sign opposite and value similar temperature coefficients of inductivity.

articleTitle: On the formation of turbulent electron beams for the generation of broadband chaotic oscillations
abstract: This work concerns the study of generators of broadband chaotic oscillations, whose work is based on new physical principles, namely the use of intense turbulent electron beams.

articleTitle: Device for excitation of eye retina for photon electroretinography
abstract: Principles of construction of the light-emitting diode device for control of excitation of a retina of an eye during photon retinography are developed. Opportunities for interactive and automation control of intensity, frequency and coordinates of main direction of light-emitting diode radiation are investigated.

articleTitle: Propagation of electromagnetic waves in anisotropic atmospheric formations
abstract: In the present paper the methodic of laboratory experimental realization in the investigation of polarization characteristics of atmospheric structures like crystal clouds is observed. The investigation results of functional characteristics of non-zero components of extinction matrixes and back-scattering matrixes of model environment versus its optical thickness and orientation angles of non-spherical particles are given.

articleTitle: Microwave probes
abstract: The microwave probes are developed for measurement systems of microcircuits on a wafer. The irregularities have been inserted into a tract of a probe to improve device characteristics.

articleTitle: Influence of aperiodicity of nanoscale structures on the resistance
abstract: Nano-scale devices are considered as an aperiodic structure based on a crystalline material. For the proposed approach the approach for quantum conductivity of materials is grounded, when the change in resistance of semiconductor working layers is determined by the concentration of free carriers generated by periodic and aperiodic power budget.

articleTitle: Shielding characteristics of materials based on sorption components with various moisture degree
abstract: Dependence of absorbing and reflecting ability of liquid-contain materials with a various degree of humidity at the range of frequencies 8-10,5 GHz is investigated. Varying a liquid-contain level of a sorption component in a material, it is possible to increase electromagnetic radiation up to 20 dB and reflecting ability up to-15 dB. Practical recommendations on generation of shielding designs for protection of objects from electromagnetic radiation have been created.

articleTitle: Parasitic oscillations of TWT in submillimeter band
abstract: Physical processes of parasitic oscillations of TWT on wavelike bent rectangular waveguides are analyzed and type of parasitic oscillations is defined. Influence of various factors on parasitic oscillations of a device is described, methods of elimination of parasitic oscillations are offered.

articleTitle: Ways to improve the security of communication channels of information transmission digital systems at the physical level
abstract: The report concerns the main ways of increasing security of communication channels of digital communication systems for departmental communication networks at the physical level.

articleTitle: The 1-MM wavelength orotron with TRPS on first space harmonic
