abstract: The results of the 1-mm wavelength orotron optimization operating on the first space harmonic of two row periodic structure (TRPS) are presented. The computer simulation methods of the electron - wave interaction efficiency investigation, which were developed for an orotron at long-wavelength range, are used. The spherocylinder was used as a focusing mirror. The cylinder longitudinal axis was parallel to the electron beam direction. The optimal TRPS length dependence vs. ohmic losses in open resonator for maximum orotron efficiency is found. The calculations were fulfilled on the bases of the results obtained in paper. It was shown that the quality of the surface treatment of TRPS plays important role. The higher is the surface quality, the shorter is the length of space interaction where the maximum efficiency is achieved and the higher is its value and the value of output power, which can be ten of watts (and more) on the first space harmonic at the narrow - electron beam with current density only 60A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Equations of general excitation for arbitrary longitudinally-irregular waveguide with finite conduction of walls
abstract: Three-dimensional equations of excitation for longitudinally-irregular circular waveguides with finite conduction of walls by electron beams in completed form for self-consistent models of gyrotrons, relativistic TWT and BWO, gyrotons and peniotrons had been derived.

articleTitle: Formation of phase composition and structure in nanodimensional films on base of CoSb3 skutterudite — Functional elements of thermoelectricity
abstract: This research is devoted to the study of formation processes of CoSb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> skutterudite phase in nanodimensional CoSb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>(30 nm)/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(100 nm)/Si(001) film systems.

articleTitle: AlGaN/GaN two-stage power amplifier of X-band
abstract: The results of development of “quasi-monolithic” two-stage power amplifier within 9-10.5 GHz bandwidth with output power in the saturation mode more than 4.0W at gain coefficient of 12.5-13 dB are presented. The experimental characteristics of designed amplifier are given.

articleTitle: Billing systems in convergent networks
abstract: The conception of the universal billing system is inspected. Functional features and principle of implementation are described. Requirements for billing in convergent networks are determined.

articleTitle: Influence of reflection on polarization efficiency of electromagnetic oscillations in waveguide ferrite polarizer
abstract: The results of researches of influence of reflecting characteristics in the waveguide ferrite polarizer of 3-cm range of electromagnetic oscillations on polarization of waves are presented in the report. The polarizer is the section of the circular waveguide with the rectangular ferrite plate in the external magnetic field of the solenoid. The reflectivity coefficient and polarization characteristics were investigated at the change of magnetic field strength and an angle of the first installation of ferrite.

articleTitle: Transmit-receive microstrip module of dopler with quasi-optical antenna for security systems
abstract: The transmit-receive microstrip module with Quasi-optical antenna is considered in the present report. The new experimental data have been described.

articleTitle: Research of system of nonlinear vibrators such as «wave channel» at nonlinear radar-location
abstract: In the work the analysis of the secondary fields which are radiated by a group of symmetric vibrators with nonlinear loads under action of radiation of nonlinear radar is submitted. The experimental analysis of efficiency of application of nonlinear radar with two monoharmonic probing signals is carried out.

articleTitle: The model of an atmospheric communication channel with phase noise
abstract: The model of the communication channel with phase noises is proposed. The prototype of synchronization system, which works at the phase noises in the communication channel, is made. The research of the pseudorandom signal spectrum is carried out depending on the shift register size in the m-sequence generator. The research results of the phase noise influence on the transmitted FM signal are presented.

articleTitle: High power intra-coupled transistor of R&PC «Istok»
abstract: The intra-matched transistor of 3 cm wavelength with output power higher than 10 W, associated gain higher than 13 dB and efficiency more than 30 % has been developed. The transistor is designed for continuous and pulse operation. Experimental results for 30 intra-coupled transistors are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Co-planar Ka-band monolithic amplifiers based on domestic GaAs mHEMT process
abstract: The design of Ka-band single- and two-stage monolithic coplanar amplifiers (CAs) based on the domestic 0.15 μm GaAs mHEMT technology is presented.

articleTitle: Stages of formation of national satellite communication system of Ukraine
abstract: A review of National satellite communication system (NSCS) of Ukraine is conducted. The basic stages of formation of the system elements are considered.

articleTitle: Scientific information access — Two way traffic
abstract: The ability of retrieval of scientific information in world scientific databases is discussed. Main performances of abstract, bibliographical and full-text databases are described.

articleTitle: On possibility of application of periodic metal-dielectric structures in practical schemes of devices of terahertz wavelength range
abstract: Analysis results of possible creation of low-voltage sources of terahertz wavelength range radiation on the basis of periodic metal-dielectric structures which may exceed the existing solid-state sources of the given wave range in output power.

articleTitle: Theory of multiharmonic superheterodyne free electron laser with longitudinal electrostatic undulator
abstract: The quadratic-nonlinear theory of multiharmonic superheterodyne free electron laser (SFEL) with the longitudinal electrostatic undulator is constructed. It is shown, that the multiple parametric resonances of the space charge waves (SCW) take place in the investigated SFEL Their growth increments do not depend on frequencies of waves. It has been found out, that multi-harmonic resonances of longitudinal waves of SCW determine the dynamics of higher harmonics of the electromagnetic signal. It is proposed to use these systems in order to form powerful multiharmonic electromagnetic signal in mm-submm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Microwave properties of composite media containnig conductive inclusions
abstract: A procedure for calculating effective electrodynamic properties of a composite material is considered. It allows considering the losses in a matrix, of which the composite is made. The influence of matrix dielectric permittivity on the properties of a composite, containing conductive particles in the form of few-coil helices, is analyzed.

articleTitle: FEL dispersion equation with account for relativistic space-charge effects
abstract: We give a qualitative derivation of a free-electron laser (FEL) dispersion equation, which takes into account not only non-relativistic (potential) but also relativistic (rotational) space-charge effects. The derivation is based on a generalisation of a dispersion equation for a Compton FEL obtained by us earlier, a certain weakly-relativistic quasistatic approximation of the space-charge field (the Darwin model), and uses an analogy between FEL and a travel wave tube (TWT). An analysis of the obtained linear growth rates is presented.

articleTitle: The investigation of regularities of the initial stages of nanoclusters' formation and of the upgrowth of the germanium-doped polycrystalline silicon nanostructural films
abstract: It is shown that the main condition, under which the process of germanium (Ge) nanoclusters and of the solid silicon-germanium solution formation takes place, is the sorption of atoms of silicon (Si) and Ge on the dielectric base. All stages of the process depend on the purity of the initial base, its orientation and chemical composition of the gas mixture. The size of Ge nanoclusters may be independently checked by the way of changing of the thickness of the polycrystalline silicon (PCS) film at the constant Ge content in its volume. Fine-scaled chaotic islets are observed for all surfaces of the initial silicon (Si) base being investigated.

articleTitle: Retracted: Mechanisms of influence of MM-waves on development physiology of fitosistems
abstract: The possibilities of compensation of defects of development of phytosystems due to the bioenergetic influence of different external fields, in particular the electromagnetic fields (EMP) of necessary frequency range and optimum power on their internal biological field. The effect of influence of AMY KVCH on development of plants has been observed at the seeds which were saved more than 10 years. The results of analysis of mechanisms of mutual influence of biological fields in addition to the energetic aspect confirm the potency of translation of genetic traits of one cellular structure into the other.

articleTitle: Efficiency increase for the choice of the virtual connection direction
abstract: The principle of selecting an outgoing logical channel, which will be hosted by a virtual connection, is developed. Thus the traffic class for which the choice of logic connection is made, queues congestion of outgoing channels, and also influence which will be rendered by the information packages arriving within the limits of the given demand, are considered. So the impact that would have been received under this proposal information packages is taken into account. Calculations are made for a self-similar model of information flow. The switching centre, which organizes connection of ATM network with a network with packets switching as per PWE3 protocol, is investigated.

articleTitle: Influence of the screw on own frequency semi-disk partially shielded quasioptical dielectric resonator and frequency of the generator stabilized by the Gunn diode
abstract: The possibility of the mechanical realignment of the frequency of a generator on a Gunn diode by a metallic or dielectric screw, carried in a partly shielded quasi-optical dielectric resonator, is considered. The model, allowing influence value in a resonator by the screw on its own frequencies and frequency of generations, in a resonator stabilized generator, is designed.

articleTitle: LFM-500D digital-signal analyzer
abstract: Short description of the device's functions and capabilities is presented. Technical solutions for monitored signal quality data accessing are studied.

articleTitle: GaAs pHEMT MMIC of the ultra broadband amplifier
abstract: There is an example of ultra broadband amplifier MMIC design based on GaAs pHEMT process. Operating frequency band is 1-4 GHz, gain is 18 dB, noise factor is lesser 2.6 dB, input/output reflection factor is less - 15 dB, unipolar power is + 5 V, consumption current is 50 mA, chip dimension is 2.5 × 1.5 × 0.1 mm.

articleTitle: Broadband monolitic IC on GaAs heterostructures for time quantized control of amplitude and phase of microwave oscillations with inbuilt driver
abstract: The results of co-developing of industrial design of monolithic integrated circuits of three types with TTL control on the basis of GaAs heterostructures, operating in the frequency range 8,0 - 12 GHz by the teams of specialists of SPE “Istok”, Moscow Institute of Electronic Technology, S. Petersburg Academic University - REC of Nanotechnologies of Russian Academy of Science are presented: 6-bit active phase switcher; 5-bit attenuator; 2-way switch; Switch operation time -10 ns

articleTitle: A virtual metod for phase shift measurement
abstract: The paper deals with the way to provide phase shift measurements between two electrical voltages using a two-channel ADC printed board and a PC within the frequency range from 0.1 Hz to 10 MHz at an error of 0.006°-0.17°.

articleTitle: Positioning using ultra-wideband chaotic radio pulses
abstract: The problem of positioning using UWB chaotic radio pulses is considered. Differential time of arrival method based on cross-correlation function of chaotic radio pulse envelope signals is proposed and investigated. It is shown that the proposed approach provides accurate estimation of time difference of arrival, proportional to the envelope signal frequency bandwidth. Immunity of the proposed method to noise increases with the duration of chaotic radio pulse.

articleTitle: Discretely tunable eleven-band noise generator
abstract: A discretely tunable eleven-band noise generator was developed based on an eleven channel switched bandpass filter. A patch antenna and a generator are manufactured of the monolithic block. Generator control is carried out over RF channel, using Bluetooth. At work of the radio-electronic equipment with confidential communication channels there is a probability of not authorized information leakage. One of the most probable channels of leak is collateral electromagnetic radiations and inducing. Noise generators are applied for protection against not authorized reading. Also noise generators are widely applied for testing and evaluating the noise immunity of radio channels of satellite communication stations.

articleTitle: Properties of cooled and superconducting linear planar microwave structures
abstract: Characteristics of cooled and superconducting linear planar structures of microwave range are considered, results of theoretical estimation and experimental researches are presented. The analysis of workabilities and restrictions of the use of such structures is carried out.

articleTitle: History of formation of global maritime and safety system
abstract: The basic stages of formation of a global maritime and safety system are presented.

articleTitle: Aspects of application of microwave scanning microscopy for diagnosis of diseases
abstract: The problem of application of microwave diagnostics in the field of medicine is considered. The basic tasks of such diacrisis have been analyzed. It has been shown that the application of microwave scanning microscopy (MSM) had been perspective for their solution. The research program of development of methods of MSM in the diagnosis of various diseases has been proposed.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic simulation of composite materials and devices on their basis
abstract: A self-consistent approach to electrodynamic analysis of different composite materials is presented. It is based on the method of integral equations for calculating current distribution in conductive inclusions and is used for further analysis of composites and devices on their basis. Method capabilities are demonstrated on the example of the problem of electromagnetic wave reflection from a layer of composite material on a metallic backing. A comparative analysis of reflection factor for a layer containing inclusions of different geometry was carried out.

articleTitle: Influence of microwave treatment on biometric characteristiics and biological mass of plantlets of common spruce
abstract: The results of researches on detection of modes of microwave exposure on seeds, which increase biometric characteristics and biological mass of common spruce, are given.

articleTitle: To 60th anniversary of Professor Gimpilevich Yury Borisovich
abstract: DIscusses the 60th anniversary of Professor Gimpilevich Yury Borisovich.

articleTitle: Interference effects in double-barrier structures in high frequency electric fields
abstract: For asymmetric double-barrier resonant-tunneling structures with thin and high (delta) barriers, the dependences of the widths of resonance levels on amplitude of intensive high frequency electric field and peculiarities of electron transport near centers of the resonance levels have been investigated. It has been observed that the non-resonance scattering channel might be absolutely transparent and level widths might substantially exceed their low-signal values.

articleTitle: Seasonal variation of high-altitude profiles of the troposphere refraction coefficient over the land
abstract: Results of experimental study of height dependences of the refraction coefficients and their gradients during various seasons are presented.

articleTitle: Variations of electron density in the regional middle latitude D-region of the ionosphere, conditioned by the morning solar terminator during magnetic storm of the 7–11th of november, 2004
abstract: The results of experimental investigations by the partial reflection radar of the electron density variations in the middle latitude ionospheric D-region during the morning solar terminator passage in the period of the magnetic storm dated the 7-11<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> of November, 2004, are presented. There was found the increase of the electron density more than 200% both in the period of the morning solar terminator passage and during tens min after this event. To explain such events a hypothesis concerning electron precipitations from the magnetosphere stimulated by the morning solar terminator is used. There were made estimations of the ionization rate. On the basis of the experimental data of electron density changes over the electron precipitation periods, corresponding fluxes were estimated, being p ≈ (0.6-8.8) 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> sec<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Development of multi-element phased antenna arrays of V-dipoles with wide-angle scanning
abstract: A large planar wide scanning phased antenna array (PAA) based on a new modification of V-dipoles has been designed for microwave applications. The infinite and finite array models are employed for electromagnetic CAD of PAA. The numerical results are in good agreement with the experimental data.

articleTitle: GYRO-TWT with high gain
abstract: The possibilities of Gyro-TWT construction with the high gain are examined. Gyro-TWT constructions on the first and second harmonics of cyclotron frequency and frequency multiplier from the fundamental harmonic to the second harmonic of cyclotron frequency are described. The analysis of the influence of the corrugation of Gyro-TWT absorbing section on the gain and efficiency of lamp is carried out.

articleTitle: F-band heterodyne vector network analyzer
abstract: The design concept of F-band heterodyne vector network analyzer is considered in this paper. The description of the flow chart, the main parameters and the results of tests of breadboard model are given.

articleTitle: Features of dispersion characteristics of frequency-selective lattices on dielectric substrates
abstract: The mathematical models of frequency-selective surfaces with dielectric covers are considered. The boundary problems are solved by the integral equations method. The integral equations are based on Lorentz's lemma in the integral form. Due to periodicity condition the decision has been reduced to surface currents determination within the Floquet channel only. The integral equation solution is executed by the moments' method. The required surface magnetic current distribution in the aperture of an array (part of the periodical array unit cell surface free of microstrip elements) is presented as decomposition on subsectional basis functions. This basis allows considering adequately current distributions features in edges. The presented numerical results of frequency-selective surfaces with dielectric covers full-wave analysis can be used for a choice of the most rational variant of FSS geometry by development of multipurpose antenna radomes in radar systems at microwaves.

articleTitle: Development of small-size pass-band filters (PBF) based on magnetostatic spin waves (MSW) in CM-frequency band with mechanical frequency tuning and high level of out-of-band blocking
abstract: Summary represents the development results of the small-size magnetostatic spin waves-based PBF devices with the frequency range from 3.0 to 18.0 GHz and the out-of-band blocking level of more than 60 dB. Dependence of the filtering devices parameters vs. a distance between the transmitting and receiving antennas has been studied of the coplanar converters, and on the operating band. Two types of the magnetic systems (MS) have been developed, which allowed constructing single-resonator and double-resonator PBF devices with minimal overall sizes. The advantages and disadvantages of the double-resonator filtering devices have been shown in comparison with the single-resonator filtering devices.

articleTitle: Express method of determination of the gas pressure optimal for microwave plasma chemical materials processing
abstract: A method of rapid determination of gas pressure value, which provides the most favorable conditions for microwave plasma chemical processing at low vacuum, is developed. The method is based on the characteristic property of microwave plasma materials processing which consists in pulsation nature of microwave discharge.

articleTitle: Water reaction on natural and artificial physical factors of extremely low intensity
abstract: This work concerns water reaction study, namely the change of water spontaneous fluctuations under the influence of extremely low intensities and other external factors.

articleTitle: Paralle computing usage for computation of the queues QoS parameters
abstract: The approach to efficient paralleling of scientific data processing is described in the article. The usage of high-performance computing for tasks solution in Telecommunications, e.g. computation of the queues QoS parameters, is analyzed.

articleTitle: Express analysis of MMIC limiters reliability based on numerical modeling of thermal processes
abstract: In the present article an express analysis of mmic limiters reliability based on numerical modeling of thermal processes are presented. The simulated results of diode maximum junction temperature versus power dissipation are shown. Experimental MTTF determination of the test diode is made.

articleTitle: Method of space-time processing of non-stationary signals with application of optimal sliding windows and wavelet transforms
abstract: This work is devoted to the development of methods of signal detection, selection and estimation of parameters of space-extended objects with high Q-factor on basis of statistical optimization of either of space-time processing of signals or dynamic scenes in the radio-technical systems.

articleTitle: Method of control of radiation characteristic of conical spiral antenna
abstract: The method of control of polarization of the radiated field is offered. It allows reducing of losses related to polarization disagreement of antennas.

articleTitle: Analysis of methods of modernization of RRL in Ukraine
abstract: The report is dedicated to the analysis of facilities and methods of modernization of RRL. The report is dedicated to the analysis of methods of modernization of RRL. Different methods of modernization of RRL, the influence of parameters of lines on quality of connection are considered. The terms of the use of different technologies of modernization of transmission have been analyzed.

articleTitle: X-band coaxial magnetron with field and secondary emitters
abstract: The findings of experimental investigations into and the field fests of the X-band cold, secondary — emission cathode magnetron referred to as "Buton" are presented. The primary — electron producing source in this system are the field emitters (FE). In addition to this, the data on 3-D simulation of the secondary-electron multiplication (SEM) process in this type of magnetron are given. The batch-produced "Buton" magnetrons are shown to offer an actual working capacity with 50ns to 6μs — width of e.m. radiation pulses. One of the noticeable features of these magnetrons installed in the transmitters of the lot-produced "Burevestnik-1" radar facility was their trouble-free operation time that lasted for over 12000 hours.

articleTitle: Use of abstract simulation at development of distributed systems
abstract: The present paper concerns problems connected with processes of development of distributed systems. The attention is especially paid to problems of their simulation. The use of simulation without associating with technologies of their implementation is proposed as a solution of this problem.

articleTitle: Influence of GaN surface morphology on characteristics of Al0,3Ga0,7N/GaN heterostructures created by molecular beam epitaxy
abstract: The technique of forming III-N layers with low defects level is developed. It is based on method of molecular beam epitaxy with atomic force microscopy using. It is demonstrated that the structure perfection of layers, which is estimated by the surface defects number, is directly connected with two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) characteristics in formed heterostructures.

articleTitle: Automatization of the measurements of spectral parameters in resonant microwave systems
abstract: In present work we introduce a measuring device that can be used for investigation of the spectral parameters in resonant microwave systems with high Q factor. The device consists of a microwave generator (G4-142), a control unit, a system of data collection, processing, and transition, PC and software for working with obtained data. Testing measurements in open resonators with dielectrics are also presented.

articleTitle: Limiter based on bandpass filter
abstract: Fundamental possibility of properties' combination of frequency selection and capacity level restriction in one device is investigated, breadboard models are created and measurements are carried out.

articleTitle: Functional condition assessment technology of the person by the frequency and time indices
abstract: The work presents the technology of reception, processing and assessment of frequency and time indices of the central nervous and cardiovascular systems of a human being to reflect his functional condition.

articleTitle: To 75-year anniversary of Professor Poplavko Yury Mikhaylovich
abstract: DIscusses the 75-year anniversary of Professor Poplavko Yury Mikhaylovich.

articleTitle: Effect of millimeter waves of low intensity on content of air dissolved in water
abstract: The concentration of air dissolved in water was studied by the method of nuclear magnetic resonance. Water was exposed to electromagnetic waves (wavelength -8 mm, the intensity -5 mW/cm2) for 6 h. During exposure, water temperature remained almost unchanged. Nevertheless, after 30-min exposure the concentration of air in water decreased, This decrease has a value that is equivalent to heating for 4°C, i.e., its effective temperature increased by 4 degrees (ΔTeff = 4°C). Exposure for 1 h additionally decreased air content in water (ΔTeff = 5.7°C). Two-hour exposure induced ΔTeff = 7.6°C, and a 3-hour exposure-ΔTeff = 8.3°C. The possibility to explain the biological effects observed after exposure of living objects to low-intensive millimeter waves, in connection to a fact of decreasing content of air in water, is discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of UHF low power rectifier based on resonant tunneling diode
abstract: UHF low power rectifier is considered. Influence of nonlinear parts' VAC vs. rectifier parameters is investigated. Conversion efficiency increased 3…10 times by means of resonant tunneling diode using. Experimental verification of mathematical model is carried out.

articleTitle: Nanoscale island Ni structures on polyimide substrate
abstract: The nanoscale island Ni structures on a polyimide substrate have been produced; their phase composition and microstructure have been investigated. The dimensions of obtained nanoparticles are in the range from 10 to 100 nanometers.

articleTitle: Application of microstrip photonic crystals for measurement of electrophysical parametres of ethanol/water mixtures
abstract: The change of real and imaginary parts of the complex permittivity of ethanol/water mixture at temperature change had been investigated.

articleTitle: Calculation of anode strap magnetrons dispersion characteristics in fundamental and higher bandpasses
abstract: The most important problem, which represents practical interest for specialists of UHF electronics and electrodynamics, is the design problem concerning M-type tube slow-wave systems with preliminary determined characteristics. Here we discussed the computation problem of electrodynamic characteristics of a resonant slow-wave structure with double straps. The dispersion characteristics of both main and higher bandpass for S-band magnetrons are shown. The geometrical dimensions to provide the best influence at the mode separation are defined.

articleTitle: Circular wave-guide application experience in autodyne short-range radar of millimeter range
abstract: The description of construction with the advantages are shown for autodyne oscillators and antennas for short-range radar of millimeter range using the circular waveguides.

articleTitle: Possibility of balancing of influence of dynamic layering of electronic stream in cherenkov super-power relativistic oscillators
abstract: On the basis of strict nonlinear theory of relativistic TWT and BWO on irregular hollow waveguides with cathode filters-modulators with the account of either propagating or beyond cut-off waves, losses in the walls of a waveguide and inhomogeneity of magnetostatic fields, directing the electronic stream, it was determined the influence of dynamic layering of the electronic beam on efficiency of the generator. Possibility of almost full compensation of influence of dynamic layering on efficiency factor at the expense of optimization of setout of the electron stream in inhomogeneous high frequency and magnetic fields and characteristics of irregular corrugated waveguide is shown.

articleTitle: Resonator measuring converter with the coaxial aperture for microobject aquametry
abstract: Numerical modeling and experimental check of resonator sensors are conducted.

articleTitle: Simulation memory cell based on tunnel magnetoresistance effect
abstract: The design of the spin memory cell on tunnel magnetoresistance effect in a magnetic tunnel junction is presented. The dynamic behavioral model and spice-macromodel of a spin memory cell are developed for using in computer simulation systems. The simulation results in static and dynamic modes have shown acceptable accuracy and adequacy of the models in comparison with the experiment.

articleTitle: Recovery of road coats and related objects parameters based on method of computation diagnostics — Dipole approximation of ground penetrating radar antennas
abstract: Several approaches, which allow increasing the reliability of diagnostics of plane layered medium in Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) applications, are considered. This increase is reached due to accurate account of parameters of transmit-receive antenna (via electrodynamic modeling) and radio frequency channel of GPR.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of basic principles of computation of radio attenuation observed in recommended guideline ITU-R P.452 and ITU-R R.1546
abstract: The comparison of calculation of radio attenuation in the recommendations ITU-R P.452, and ITU-R R.1546 has been carried out. In the process of analysis the differences has been revealed: the first, calculates attenuation throughout the flight path in detail, and the second, uses approximized empirical curves. It follows that the recommended guideline ITU-R P.452 is for precise calculations, and ITU-R R.1546 is for "fast".

articleTitle: Complex amplitude measurement unit in a microwave imaging system
abstract: A microwave image super-heterodyne receiver unit is described. IF signals are sampled and then processed to obtain scattered field complex amplitude. Such receiver design simplifies hardware part of the device.

articleTitle: The experimental analysis of self-synchronization influence on the susceptibility of the microwave generator at influence of interference
abstract: In given work the experimental research of the new design susceptibility of the microwave generator with an external additional feedback (EAF) [1] to external influences have been made, also it is found out, that the generator susceptibility with EAF approximately 3 dB less than at work of this generator in its usual independent mode.

articleTitle: Excitation of diffraction radiation oscillator with double grating on higher space harmonics
abstract: The experimental researches of the diffraction radiation oscillators (DRO) in millimeter waves range with the double periodic grating optimized for operation on the higher space harmonics are presented. The field amplitude magnification in a grating is revealed under a grating period increase.

articleTitle: Patterned ferromagnetic nanostructures
abstract: Results of investigations of ferromagnetic nanostructures enclosing the monolayer ferromagnetic nanodisks of various forms as well as multilayer ferromagnetic nanomagnets are presented. Methods of magnetic force microscopy were applied to observe magnetic states in such nanosystems. We have produced the spin-valve elements on the basis of CoFe/AlO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>/CoFe, which perform the 10% alteration of the effect of tunneling magnetoresistance. We have also proved that in three layer Co/Si/Co/Si/Co nanomagnets with magnetostatic interaction between layers the helicoidal states of magnetization might be realized.

articleTitle: The origin of fine structure of dynamic spectrums of solar radio bursts
abstract: The analysis of multibeam propagation of radio waves in the solar plasma was performed. A formula (a mathematical model) for the calculation of structure of dynamic spectrums of flare radio bursts was got. Similarity of calculated and observed dynamic spectrums is not indicative of formation of fine structure of spectrums in the source of emission, but as a result of wave propagation through the inhomogeneous environment and interplanetary space.

articleTitle: Wideband irradiators for digital active phased antenna array
abstract: The process of designing of digital active phased antenna array (PAA) is described. Antenna elements can operate in wide frequency band. The comparison of experimental or calculated results is presented. The recommendations on PAA modernization and characteristics improvement are presented.

articleTitle: Electrically small antennas for space vehicles
abstract: The results of researches and designing of electrically small antennas for rocket-space and aviation equipment are present.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation model for telecommunication networks
abstract: We consider options to evaluate the effectiveness of the telecommunications network.

articleTitle: Cathodoluminescent spectroscopy and electric properties of MODFETs of AlxGa1−xN/GaN at impact of proton irradiation 1.8 MeV
abstract: The cathodoluminescent spectroscopy (CLS) in order to examine AlGaN/GaN modulation-doped field-effect transistors that display degraded source-drain current characteristics after 1.8-MeV proton irradiation, along with bulk heterojunctions of materials of field-effect transistor. For both cases, we have observed distinct changes in the spectral emission features due to decreased internal electric-field strength and new point defects within different layers of the device structure with the nanometer-scale depth resolution. These changes might be accounted for the degraded electrical characteristics. The degradation of Al-GaN/GaN high electron mobility transistors due to 1.8-MeV proton irradiation was measured at fluence up to 310<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>. The devices have much higher mobility than AlGaN/GaN devices, but they possess high radiation tolerance, exhibiting little degradation at fluence up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>. Decreased sheet carrier mobility due to the increased carrier scattering and the decreased sheet carrier density due to the carrier removal are primary damage mechanisms. The device degradation has been observed with the decrease in the maximum transconductance, the increase in the threshold voltage, and the decrease in the drain saturation current.

articleTitle: Close range coverage ship radar with distance high resolution
abstract: Close range coverage ship radar with high (1.5 m) resolution at range was developed and implemented for navigation of boats as well as for lay-up and mooring of super-size vessels. Examples of the radar-tracking images obtained during natural tests of “River” radar manufactured as a small lot by Micran Co. (Tomsk, Russia) are given.

articleTitle: Doppler radar method for plasma structure investigation
abstract: The stratified positive column of glowing discharge plasma was investigated using coherent homodyne measuring transmitter-receiver equipment. The estimation of absolute cross-section of stratified plasma creations was carried out experimentally. Frequency dependencies of a reflected signal from plasma creation have been presented.

articleTitle: Electrophysical and mechanical characteristics of metal — Nanostructured P-SI contacts with Schottky barrier
abstract: Current-voltage characteristics of metal — nanostructured p silicon structure, which was received by the chemical machining in etchant Si layers superficial at SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-Si structures, are investigated in the present work. It is established that current depends on electrical voltage according to I ∼ U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. It confirms the injection character of these currents. Reverse current is influenced on by properties of potential Schottky barrier.

articleTitle: Calculation of criteria of electromagnetic compatibility for Wi-Fi network in range 2400–2480 MHz
abstract: The assessment criteria of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for networks of broadband access and calculation methods are considered. Estimation of numerical values of the criterion for TD Wi-Fi networks in the range 2400-2480 MHz with the propagation model of a desired signal and interference by referral of ITU-R P. 452 is carried on.

articleTitle: Efficiency upgrading of data transfer in mobile networks
abstract: Traffic intensity of data transmission in modern mobile networks produces a huge load. Unloading procedures of networks, in particularly WiFi offload, are considered.

articleTitle: Organizational and technical measures against control of electromagnetic compatibility in the process of integration of broadband wireless networks of frequency range 3400–3900 MHz
abstract: Organizational and technical measures against control of electromagnetic compatibility in the process of integration of broadband wireless networks and satellite service earth stations in the joint use of frequency bands 3400–3900 MHz are considered.

articleTitle: The properties of the radio-beacon designed for "Phobos-Grunt" and "Moon-Resource" projects
abstract: A radio-beacon is an ultra-stable oscillator that has been developed in order to operate as a navigation unit and a scientific unit in the “celestial mechanics” experiment (the investigation of the gravity field's parameters) as a part of Russian space projects “Phobos-Grunt” and “Moon-Resource”. The device should radiate ultra-stable signals in ranges X and Ka. Spectral and power characteristics of the device are the cores for the execution of the tasks in view.

articleTitle: Characteristics of microwave phase error of digital signal processing in digital antenna array
abstract: The article concerns the impact of DSP on the directional characteristics of digital antenna arrays. The relationship between the conversion to digital form and phase errors is considered.

articleTitle: Measuring prosedure of parameters of sensing in IPTV systems
abstract: Necessity of application of quality factors of sensation for assessment of IPTV system is confirmed. Ranking and analytical comparison of existing QoE metrics for IPTV systems is carried on. Requirement of development of a new mathematical model of QoE metrics is shown.

articleTitle: Measurements of radar cross section and detectability of vessels at conditions of testing ground
abstract: Meter features of radar characteristics of vessels in conditions of testing ground are considered. Sevastopol was chosen as a training ground. It was established in the end of previous century, but its technical and methodical levels correspond to the most modern requirements. Thus the experience practice and devised techniques might be used on other testing grounds in the world. The main stress is given to the problems of measurement of detectability of ships and radar images in the X-wave band. The measurement data is presented and its accuracy is analyzed.

articleTitle: Investigation of properties of coupled and spiral dielectric resonators in millimeter waves
abstract: The results of experimental study of spectral, power and field characteristics of single, half-disk, spiral resonators as well as coupled disk dielectric resonators (DDR) with whispering gallery modes (WGM) in the millimeter waveband by means of the computerized measuring stand are presented. Possibility of design of controlled EHF elements and modeling of microresonator structures on the basis of coupled DDR's for the probable application in terahertz and optical frequency ranges are discussed.

articleTitle: Infrared and terahertz detectors on basis of superconducting nanostructures
abstract: Results of development of single-photon receiving systems of visible, infrared and terahertz range based on thin-film superconducting nanostructures are presented. The receiving systems are produced on the basis of superconducting nanostructures, which function by means of hot-electron phenomena.

articleTitle: NDC of diodes with tunnel and resonant-tunneling borders
abstract: The diodes, in which negative differential conductivity (NDC) arises at certain stresses between ohmic contacts owe to tunneling or resonant tunneling of electrons through lateral borders of the diode, are considered, and their current-voltage characteristics are determined in the present paper.

articleTitle: Non-faraday capacitance sensors based on nanoporous anodic aluminium oxide passivating films
abstract: It is shown that the silanization of the surface assists enhancement of homogeneous polarization properties of the passivating cover on base of the nanoporous aluminum oxide in non-faraday capacitance sensors, usable for studying of the microorganisms' growth. A new immunochemical method of differentiated diagnostics of the A(H1N1) И B influenza viruses is proposed.

articleTitle: To 60th anniversary of Pavel Petrovich Yermolov
abstract: DIscusses the 60th anniversary of Pavel Petrovich Yermolov.

articleTitle: The structure of the field in the coaxial aperture of cavity probe for scanning microwave microscopy
abstract: The structure of the field in the sample studied with near-field scanning microwave microscope based on coaxial cone resonator is investigated. Dependencies of changes of a probe tip shape, field distribution with changing electrophysical parameters of sample are obtained.

articleTitle: Contribution of Russian engineers to Malabar arc radio station construction
abstract: The history of Malabar arc radio station, the most powerful in the world, on the island of Java in the beginning of the 20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> century is presented. The role of the Russian radio engineers and their participation in the radio station construction is considered.

articleTitle: Mobile operator services and charging policy management
abstract: The article main task is to find out such parameters in 4G systems, which affect the charging procedure and can increase the profit of carrier.

articleTitle: Concatenated helicon isolators
abstract: The possibility of extension of helicon isolators bandwidth up to octave is discussed. Expected extension is obtained from concatenation of two resonance helicon isolators. Two most efficient constructions of concatenation were selected from the variety. Symmetry of scheme design facilitates the isolators matching with transmission lines.

articleTitle: A wideband 700–1000 MHz short-pulse SiC 300W power amplifier
abstract: Results of design and experimental investigation of 700-1000 MHz SiC short-pulsed amplifier with output power upper 300W are presented in this article.

articleTitle: Improving the efficiency of the information flow transfer
abstract: It is proposed to improve the well-known principle of weighted circular service queues, which involves the redistribution package from a high-priority queue into a low-priority one in order to smooth out unexpected load peaks characteristic for self-similar traffic.

articleTitle: Heating efficiency of chemical reagents in the microwave cavity
abstract: Relationships for technical calculation of the parameters of reactors with microwave heating of chemical reagents are presented. The range of variation of microwave properties of the reactor during variation of reagent properties is estimated, and the coupling parameters of the resonator with the external line providing high efficiency are determined. The experimental data of the absorption degree of microwave energy by different chemical objects in the high-Q resonator are obtained.

articleTitle: Prospects of development of radiation-resistant voltage converters on domestic element base
abstract: Statements of reason of development of block power supplies are given. Characteristics of the modules produced on the import element base and possibilities of their realization on domestic radiation-resistant element base are considered.

articleTitle: Microwave planar antennas for telecommunication devices based on magnetic nano-structures (Spin-torque nano-oscillators)
abstract: Theoretical investigation of possible application of microwave planar antennas for the development of telecommunication devices based on magnetic nano-structures (MNS) (spin-torque nano-oscillators) is presented. It is shown that coplanar antennas have some advantages in comparison with other types of antennas. The performance of the antennas in a frequency range 1-5 GHz is estimated, and it is shown that considered antennas have sufficiently good parameters and can be used for the development of telecommunication devices based on MNS.

articleTitle: Digital antenna array with microwave photonic components
abstract: Design considerations are presented and structural configuration of digital antenna array (DAA) with fiber-optic microwave signal distribution system is proposed. The latter provides phase stabilized multichannel transmission of microwave signals received by array antenna elements to digital processing unit (DPU). Compared with conventional coax-waveguide analogs fiber-optic distribution system proposed provides high bandwidth, small losses, less values of noise figure and amplitude-phase distortions and essentially better weight-size characteristics.

articleTitle: Characteristics of hybrid multiwall nanotubes
abstract: The model of transistor nanostructure on the basis of hybrid five-wall nanotube (NT) consisting of three carbon one-wall NT with metallic properties between which two boron-azotic NTs are allocated, has been developed. Considering the carbon nanotubes (CNTs) as contact electrodes of the cathode, the anode and the control electrode, it is obviously possible to drive tunnel current of structure by means of potentials on the anode and the control electrode both at room temperature and at low (~20 K) temperatures.

articleTitle: Experimental results of the RTW model study in fiber-optic communication line of telecommunication system
abstract: The problem of increase of information transfer rate using fiber-optical communication lines is an actual problem connected with development of Internet, MPEGaudio/video, IP-telephony, multimedia, digital TV. Considering that transfer rate for SDH-technology is 155 Mbit/sec, and SDH networks replace thousand kilometers of public telephone network, and taking into account results of made experiments, a technical decision is offered. It is directed to decrease of transferred signal distortions, loss compensation in a line, in order to improve regenerative, functional characteristics of fiber-optical systems of transfer.

articleTitle: Calculation of descending communication line characteristics of the satellite repeater with the transistor power amplifier
abstract: Optimization of satellite repeater parameters with transistor power amplifiers is carried out as per the criterion of a minimum of an error of demodulation for a case of transmission through a communication line of the digital information great volume at the restricted strip of operating frequencies (4 %) relative frequencies of carrying frequency and when using Comtech CDM-700 modem on the Earth. The sender is installed on a HEO space vehicle. Dependences of probability of bit error rate for QPSK and 8PSK signals and various values of path attenuation are obtained.

articleTitle: Diode damage under action of pulse edge
abstract: The estimation of damage of p-n junction on short pulse front is presented.

articleTitle: Lack of adequate level of radio connection in armed forces as one of decisive factors in tragic losses of our troops in 1905 and in 1941
abstract: On the examples from the national history it has been shown that the underestimation of the role of radio in Army in 1905 by tsar government had led to the tragedy of Tsushima and, ultimately, to the defeat of Russia in Russian-Japanese war. The political leadership of Stalin of USSR did not make the correct conclusions from that lesson. In summer of 1941 the lack of radio communication in units of Red Army did not allow the effective management of Soviet troops from Moscow and coordination of their combat operations and creation of stable defense. As a result, in November 1941 our human losses reached catastrophic proportions, huge territories to the west of Volga were captured by the enemy.

articleTitle: Simulation of single-electron semiconductor devices with calculation of various factors
abstract: The influence of various factors on the results of calculation of IV-characteristics of the single-electron semiconductor devices is investigated with the use of the physical model.

articleTitle: Even sampling method for simulation of electron devices with irregular electrodynamic systems
abstract: The method of even sampling for solution of ordinary differential equation is proposed. Its high effectiveness is demonstrated on the example of propagation of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub>-mode in an irregular waveguide with a circular section.

articleTitle: Temperature investigation of FMR frequency-field dependences in uniaxial hexaferrite SrFe11.2Al0.8O19
abstract: The experimental investigations of the FMR frequency-field dependences at room temperature T=300 K and temperature of liquid nitrogen T=77K for the substituted sample of strontium hexaferrite SrFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11.2</sub>Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sub> are presented. It is shown, that with decrease of temperature the difference dH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">hys</sub> between the field of saturation H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</sub> and the field of breaking H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">br</sub> (dH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">hys</sub>=H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</sub> - H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">br</sub>) is changed insignificantly.

articleTitle: Decoupling of two horn antennas by means of impedance structure
abstract: Possibility of isolation of transmitting and receiving horn antennas by means of impedance structure is shown.

articleTitle: Spectrum of dielectric spherical resonator forced by azimuthally periodical electrical current
abstract: Spectral characteristics of an isotropic spherical dielectric resonator placed into isotropic medium forced by azimuthally periodical electrical current that flows in the sphere equatorial plane is studied. It is shown that this current excites E and H modes. If the frequency of ring current radiation coincides with the frequency of eigenmode there is an amplitude resonance in oscillating system.

articleTitle: AlGaN/GaN two-stage power amplifier of C-band
abstract: A two-stage amplifier on AlGaN/GaN heterostructure transistors has been designed for the use within 5-7 GHz frequency range. Linear gain amounts to 20±1.0 dB, input reflection factor does not exceed 10 dB. With input power of 200 mW, the output power of the amplifier is not less than 5.4 W, coefficient of efficiency is not less than 28%. Area of QMIC is 2.2×3.8mm.

articleTitle: Arrangement device for analysis of radiopulse signals
abstract: The results of a design of a device for analysis of radiopulse signals with determination of their parameters are considered.

articleTitle: Intracoupled X-band transistor of R&PC «Istok» with power output 14 W
abstract: The intra-coupled transistor of 3 cm wavelength in the metal-and-ceramic case with output power 14 W, gain more than 8 dB and efficiency factor higher than 30 % has been developed. Transistor is designed for continuous and pulse operation. The experimental results for 30 intra-matched transistors are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Use of double frequency radar for measurement of reflectance-intensity dependence
abstract: The results of study of double frequency method of remote sensing of liquid precipitation are presented for measurement of their intensity. Also the calculation algorithm of dependence of radar reflectance vs. rain intensity is described and main results of numerical simulation are discussed.

articleTitle: Spin-torque magnetic nano-structures as microwave sources
abstract: In experimental microwave sources based on spin-torque magnetic nano-structures (MNS) the power is extracted as oscillation of the device magnetoresistance (MR). The goal of our work is to evaluate the magnitude of the microwave power that can be extracted from a MNS through the oscillating dipolar fields when the MNS is coupled to different microwave systems, and to compare this power with the power that can be extracted through the traditional MR mechanism. We demonstrate that, although for a single MNS the MR mechanism is much more efficient than the direct dipolar electromagnetic emission, the latter mechanism can have a significant advantage in the case of a sufficiently large array of synchronized MNS placed in a microwave resonator.

articleTitle: Fixed OFDM envelopes with channel coding
abstract: The article concerns investigation and use of convolutional coding for fixed envelopes in the data transmission system based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexed channels. It is shown that the noise at the output of phase demodulator (in OFDM receiver) with high signal/noise ratio and relatively low rates of modulation can be represented as Gaussian noise. This allows using conventional metrics in Vitberi's decoding algorithm.

articleTitle: Determination of law of fluctuations of back scattering diagram of underlying surfaces on basis of results of radiophysical investigations
abstract: The method of determination of law of fluctuations of BSD of various US, which were obtained as a result of remote probing and are required for development of catalogues of scattering signatures, is suggested.

articleTitle: Establishing and development of Radioengineering & Telecommunications Department of Sevastopol National Technical University (dedicated to 50-year anniversary)
abstract: Considered in this paper are the stages of establishing and development of Radioengineering & Telecommunications Department of Sevastopol National Technical University, which has celebrated its 50-year anniversary in May, 2010.

articleTitle: Expansion of dynamic band and decrease of insertion losses of devices on basis of magnetostatic waves
abstract: Amplitude-frequency characteristics of a device on the basis of magnetostatic waves were experimentally investigated in the frequency band 2 - 8 GHz and at the levels of input signal power 0.06mW-600mW. The undoped YIG film with saturation induction 1750G was applied in the device. The orientation of external magnetic field was at the plane transversal to the direction of propagation of magnetostatic waves. For different frequency bands the existence of optimum angles of magnetic biasing at which losses of the device were minimal was proved. So at input signal power of 600mW, frequency tuning in the band 1.9 GHz - 2.3 GHZ with the angle of magnetic biasing 8° and in the band from 2.35 GHz up to 2.85 GHZ for the angle 12° the insertion losses of the device did not exceed 6.5 Db. It was shown, that achievement of rather small insertion losses at frequencies lower than 3.27 GHz became possible due to providing conditions of wave generation and propagation of nonreciprocal magnetostatic volume.

articleTitle: Two-section TWT with correcrion of slowing by variation in forms of dielectric rods
abstract: The spiral TWT in which the dielectric rods, anchoring a coil, made of a material, cross-section of which vary along the interaction area, is used, ensuring the demanded smooth operation by augmentation of slowing.

articleTitle: Enzyme inactivation by low power microwave irradiation
abstract: The scope of tasks and positive tendencies in the area of analysis of mechanisms of realization of curative effect of the electromagnetic radiation taking into account the synergetic phenomena are submitted. Thus free radicals appear and the cascade of reactions starts, which ends with structural rupture and inactivation of enzymes.

articleTitle: Compound algorithms for simulation of electron devices with irregular waveguides
abstract: Compound methods for solution of boundary problems for irregular waveguides with the use of statements of carry and averaging are suggested.

articleTitle: "Radio technology" concept in historiography of science and technology
abstract: Determined in this paper is “radio technology” concept, as extending term in historiography of science and technology.

articleTitle: Autonomous impulsive-frequency oscillator with parabolic reflector
abstract: In the report compact pulsed oscillator powered by 150 kV voltage source with control pulse repetition frequency from single-pulse modes up to 800 Hz is described. Hertz radiator with parabolic reflector has been used in the oscillator.

articleTitle: Public key of cryptography over extended Galois fields
abstract: RSA-like public-key cryptosystem that allows high-speed encryption and decryption is developed. The security of a system is based on the complexity of finding of irreducible polynomials over extended Galois fields.

articleTitle: Influence of GAMMA-irradiation on elements of submicron cmos integrated circuits
abstract: The results of experimental researches of radiation resistance of element base of 0,35 μm CMOS integrated circuits at influence of gamma-irradiation Co<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup> are submitted.

articleTitle: Design of 7 kW C-band solid state modular transmitter
abstract: A powerful 7kW C-band transmitter system for satellite communication was designed and tested. A flexible Redundancy-Combining™ configuration lets providers combine the power of two transmitters in heavy communication traffic, or use one of the transmitters in a redundant configuration to preserve high system reliability.

articleTitle: Designing of multimesa IMPATT diodes of MM wave band in microsecond pulsed operation regime
abstract: Theoretical calculations of overall pulse thermal resistance of mulltimesa IMPATT diodes are carried out. The possibility of its sufficient reduction for impulse IMPATT diodes of 8-mm wave band at pulse length of power supply 5 μs in 2,3 times, at duration 10 μs in 3 times is shown. The examples of possible configurations of n-mesa constructions at n = 12-100 are submitted.

articleTitle: Influence of turbulent troposphere fluctuations on the radiointerferometer operation
abstract: The present paper concerns the Influence of turbulent troposphere fluctuations on angle of radio waves' arrival measurement accuracy by means of a radiointerferometer for evaluation of troposphere refraction properties Characteristics of the radiointerferometer have been obtained by means of statistic simulation method.

articleTitle: Multisection TWT of submillimeter band
abstract: Results of investigations of one, two and three section TWT on wavelike bent rectangular waveguides are presented. It is shown, that gain of multisection TWTs might reach 30–60 dB. The analysis of physical processes in such TWTs was carried out; type of a mode of self-excitation was defined. It was observed that gain band depended on the length of drift tubes. Electronic returning of gain band is possible.

articleTitle: Calculation of the spectrum of fundamental optical absorption compounds A3B5
abstract: The work presents a model for the calculation of the spectral dependence of the intrinsic absorption edge of semiconductor solid solutions with a direct energy band structure at the example of GaAs. It can be used in mathematical models that describe the work of photoelectric converters.

articleTitle: Generators of microwave chaos on lumped elements
abstract: This work concerns the development of methods of simulation and experimental realization of ultra-wideband microwave chaotic generators on lumped components.

articleTitle: Account of surface charge and scattering in two-band model of RTD
abstract: The influence of the surface charge and scattering on epy electrical characteristics of RTD based on GaAs/AlAs was investigated with the use of combined two-band model. Sufficient agreement of the results with the experimental data was obtained.

articleTitle: Current distribution in radial impedance monopole on spherical scatterer
abstract: In the present report the solution of the problem of electrical current distribution along thin radial impedance monopole, located on perfectly conducting sphere, has been found in pure electrodynamical statement. The approximate analytical solution of the integral equation has been obtained by the method of iterations both for the case of excitation of the monopole by a 5-generator of voltage, located at finite distance over the spherical scatterer, and at the excitation of the monopole at its basis.

articleTitle: Feed scheme of the circular groove-type antenna with circular polarization
abstract: The feed system of a ring slot antenna for circular polarization is investigated. An equivalent model of the extensive feed system and results of antenna characteristic searching are presented.

articleTitle: Design ultra wide band compositon element-based CM and MM band mathematical model approach
abstract: As a result of mathematical modeling the ultrawideband wave-guides of the device on waveguides of cross-section complex shapes are developed: - Polarizing waveguide adders in CM range. With size of VSWR not exceeding 1.15, the outcome is not less than 30Db. Switches are on the basis of complex cross-section waveguides - VHF devices on H-waveguides in mm-waveband directed (attenuation of 30 to 40, 50 dB, orientation is not less than 30 dB) with a coaxial output in the branched arm, waveguide-to-coaxial adapters, load to the high level of capacity with fluid heat rejection (VSWR not exceeding 1.1 at accepted power of 50 and 500 Wt).

articleTitle: Experimental estimation of interference impact of transmitting equipment of fixed service on receive paths of land mobile service with joint use of frequency bands
abstract: Results of experimental estimation of interference impact of transmitting equipment of low bit-rate digital radio relay station (DRRS) on receive paths of land mobile service with joint use of radiofrequencies VHF and UHF are considered.

articleTitle: A L-S-band low-noise 1W GaN amplifier
abstract: The present paper concerns comparison of 1–9 GHz noise characteristics of commercial available power GaAs-based transistors and GaN-based devices. Results of design and experimental investigation of high dymanic range 0.8–2.7 GHz GaN-based LNA are also presented in this article.

articleTitle: Optical interconnections on basis of nanostructured silicon embedded in anodic alumina
abstract: The design and technology of manufacturing of optical interconnections on the basis of nanostructured silicon have been developed. The optoelectronic couple with conversion coefficient of current of about 1% has been produced. The possibility of integration of optical and electron interconnections on the silicon chip is demonstrated.

articleTitle: F-class amplifier on basis of metamaterials in 16QAM system
abstract: The design principles of f-class amplifier of frequency range 5.8 GHz on the basis of composite right-left handed (CRLH) transmission line (TL) are developed. The structure (fig.1) uses two open CRLH tuners for the suppression of the second, the third, the fourth and the fifth harmonics, and the fundamental frequency has been matched at 50 ohms. The characteristics of 16QAM (64QAM) system with the use of designed amplifier are investigated.

articleTitle: The radiothermometry of biological objects in the radio frequency range
abstract: The measuring device designed for measurement of own radio-thermal radiation of biological objects in radio frequency range is proposed. The practical estimation of the device resolving power for the spectral power density, confirming the device applicability for the study of biological objects, is done.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of methods of frequency-territorial planning of networks WIMAX
abstract: An algorithm of carrying out of analysis of the methods of frequency-territorial planning of network WIMAX IEEE 802.16 is offered.

articleTitle: Approach to formation of cell libraries of MMIC and automatic layout generation for electromagnetic simulation
abstract: A systematical approach to formation of cell libraries (PDKs) of MMIC is presented. Also, a procedure allowing automatic MMIC layout generation for specified foundry process is developed in Microwave Office (MWO) CAD tool. These results are used in developing of a pilot version of PDK for 0.15 μm pHEMT/mHEMT GaAs process.

articleTitle: The role of some signaling and effector systems in realization of anti-inflammatory action of extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation
abstract: Reactions of some signaling and effector systems responsible for realization of anti-inflammatory effects of extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EHF EMR) were studied. It was found that low-intensity EHF EMR with certain parameters caused genoprotective action, increased the level of immune resistance of the organism, and significantly increased the content of some polyunsaturated fatty acids in thymus of exposed animals that led to creation of specific profile of inflammation mediators providing anti-inflammatory effect.

articleTitle: Instrumentation for measurements of nonlinear distortion of microwave UWB signals
abstract: The results of the research and development of the instrumentation for measurement of UWB nonlinear distortion are shown. Calculations of application of measuring systems with limiting frequency 1.5 and 18 GHz are presented.

articleTitle: Applicative implementation of radio-relay stations with precise time system
abstract: Practical results of proposed technical solutions used in radio-relay stations (RRS) with precise time system to perform accurate scientific or navigational measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of probability of optimisation of geometrical dimensions of double-gap cavities
abstract: The technique of estimation of optimal geometrical parameters of double-gap cavities is offered. It is shown, that there is an optimal value of accelerating voltage where magnitude of the criterion of optimization reaches the maximal value. It has been calculated, that the value of this parameter for double-gap cavities surpasses in 4-5 times the value of parameter of optimization for one-gap cavities.

articleTitle: Microwave chaotic pulse generation in ring self-oscillating system based on CMOS structure
abstract: In the process of simulation and experimentally the possibility of formation of microwave chaotic pulse stream in the ring self-oscillatory system realized on CMOS-structures [1] is shown.

articleTitle: Grid-service centre of telecommunication system of images recognition of medical objects
abstract: The problem of establishment of Grid-centre linked up with medical institutions by means of data network that transmits and compresses images of medical and biological objects for further recognition is considered. Image recognition is realized upon terms and conditions of information-extreme intellectual technology of analysis and synthesis of the self-learning recognition systems.

articleTitle: Adaptive OFDM modem — Basis of LTE network physical layer
abstract: The Long Term Evolution (LTE) network organization features were analyzed. Some engineering proposals for physical layer realization simplification are presented. The OFDM modem block diagram including directional diagram forming block for MIMO and Beamforming technologies is developed. The advantages of ring antenna arrays using for cell searching are shown.

articleTitle: Onset of regime of generalized synchronization in mutually coupled beam-plasma systems
abstract: The regime of generalized synchronization in mutually coupled beam-plasma systems with overcritical current has been found. The origination of synchronous regime is proved to be connected with transition of one of positive Lyapunov exponents into negative values. Obtained results are confirmed by the nearest-neighbor method.

articleTitle: Cooperative multi-user MIMO broadband radio access system deployment
abstract: MIMO concept has revolutionized the telecommunications world and brought the capacity limits far beyond those described in classic Shannon's work. Multiuser MIMO (MU-MIMO) is to broaden the MIMO applications to the multiuser environment thus enabling the broadband radio access system to be more reliable and facilitated for its deployment. We suggest that the cooperation principle is also used to save all MU-MIMO gains and to make the system performance more optimal. Thus, this article concerns broadband radio access systems deployment based on MU-MIMO technology with cooperation.

articleTitle: Investigation of variants of power supply schemes for microwave magnetron average power for plasma processing of materials
abstract: The results of experimental research of plasma radiation optical signal depending on the pressure in the plasmatron chamber, using the different electrical networks of microwave magnetron power supply, are presented.

articleTitle: Determination of dielectric permittivity of substances by means of geometric-phase scanning
abstract: The method of determination of permittivity of substances is presented with the use of a radiator with geometric-phase scanning. The conditions, providing minimization of errors at realization of measurements in the intermediate zone of radiation, are determined.

articleTitle: Passive limiter on the diodes shottkey of L-, S-, C-, X-band
abstract: Results of design of L-, S-, C-, X-band passive limiter are presented. Example of L-, S-, C-, X-band limiter broadband loss characteristics are shown. The limiter is developed by "NPP "Planeta-Argall". The limiter can be used in entrance sections of communication equipment, navigators and radar stations.

articleTitle: Simulation and experimental investigation of coplanar elements for design of MMIC
abstract: Simulation and measurement results of distributed and lumped elements used in GaAs MMICs with coplanar lines at frequency range up to 50 GHz are presented. Based on these data, an accuracy of models for MMIC coplanar elements has been estimated.

articleTitle: Synthesis of ferrite perovskite composite materials and maximization of wave transmission in these mediums
abstract: The peculiarities of sectionally-uniform medium with high level of susceptibilities and small losses of field are described, as well as method of increasing of resulting coefficient of field transmission into the medium due to sequence of its intermediate layers with characteristics, which minimize wave transmission have been submitted.

articleTitle: Effects of microwave electric and stationary magnetic fields on electrooptical properties of nematic liquid crystals with carbon nanotubes
abstract: Investigations of electrophysical properties of nematic liquid crystals {LC) based on cyanobiphenyls under the frequency of 10–10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> GHz with applied electric and magnetic static fields are presented. The obtained results are interpreted in terms of molecular models. Possibilities of LC implementation into various electronic devices are also discussed in this thesis.

articleTitle: Surface magnetostatic wave filters with magnetron sputtered nanoscale films of yttrium iron garnet
abstract: Results of operation of MSSW filters with nano-scale films of yttrium iron garnet are presented. The peculiarities of filter characteristics are discussed. Nanoscale films in MSSW filter are used for broadening of input signal dynamical range due to the realization of single domain state in YIG films even at low magnetic field 1E. The use of nanoscale YIG films in MSSW filters allows increasing of frequency selective characteristics of these devices in the decimeter microwave range. MSSW filters with films grown by the magnetron sputtering have low insert losses in comparison with films grown by LPE.

articleTitle: Infra red radiation shielding efficiency of liquid-containing composite materials
abstract: We offer the composite liquid-containing material based on the capillary-porous matrixes impregnated with a hygroscopic inorganic salt solution and with two sides covered with crystalline water-retentive polymer layers. Time behavior of composite materials surface temperature is obtained. Dependence of IR-radiation shielding efficiency on composition and structure of the composite material is studied.

articleTitle: Radiometric survey of dielectric materials
abstract: The methods of radio thermal and radio wave investigations in free space of parameters of dielectric materials are considered and separate results of measurements are shown. Sounding was carried out on the basis of estimation of power of proper radiated radio thermal signals, and also signals from the outside source passed through the object of research and reflected from it.

articleTitle: Chaotic autosoliton geneator on the basis of 1D magnon crystal
abstract: The experimental investigation of the autonomous generation of the periodical chaotic dissipative solitons (autosolitons) sequences has been provided. The self-oscillator including the transistor power amplifier and the nonlinear delay line based on the one-dimensional periodic ferromagnetic microstructure (magnon crystal) was considered. The magnetostatic surface wave (MSW) was excited in this structure.

articleTitle: The mechanism of high level noise generation by double-drift avalanche diodes in anomalous mode
abstract: The anomalous mode of double-drift avalanche diodes uses combined state and impulse supply for a diode. The inclusion of diode in multi-loop system allows increasing the level of own generated noises owe to current and voltage ripple in due time. The double-drift avalanche diodes in a multi-loop circuit work as a noise oscillator with a heightened level and non-linear capacity which causes a boost of these noises.

articleTitle: Ferroelectric non-hysteresis actuator for microwave tuneable devices
abstract: Low loss and highly tuneable microwave filters controlled by piezoelectric actuator are discussed. Dielectric or metallic parts of device should have the piezo-dirigible air gap between them. The most important for these devices is to use non-hysteresis relaxor ferroelectric ceramics with large electrostriction. Electromechanic way of control has restriction in the speed of operation, and this problem is estimated by the microwave investigation of relaxor ceramics that is used as main actuator material.

articleTitle: Influence of meso-substituted porphyrins derivatives molecular structure on their liquid-cristal properties and supramolecular organization in floating layers
abstract: The 4 new meso-substituted tetraphenylpor-phyrins and their metal complexes with (-OC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</inf>) in orto-or para-positions were studied to evaluate the influence of molecular structure peculiarities on mesomorphism and supramolecular packing in floating layers. We have studied mesomorphism of bulk samples, its dependence on porphyrins' structure and substituents' position, as well as the influence of substituents position on supramolecular organization of meso-substituted porphyrins' derivatives in floating layers.

articleTitle: Waveguide-dielectric resonator at 28–38 GHz
