abstract: Calculation data of resonance frequencies and eigen Q-factors of a fundamental electromagnetic oscillation of magnetic type in a waveguide-dielectric resonator (WDR) for millimeter wave band are presented. On the basis of carried out calculations WDR has been designed at frequency range 28–38 GHz and its parameters were measured.

articleTitle: Equipment of matter heating in HF electromagnetic field
abstract: The method and equipment of HF heating of different matters are considered.

articleTitle: Yagi-Uda antenna with impedance vibrators
abstract: The solution of a problem of current distribution in Yagi-Uda antenna with impedance vibrators is represented. The influence of surface impedance of the vibrators on electrodynamical characteristics of considered structure has been investigated.

articleTitle: The investigation of signals of chaotic microwave generators with internal electronic and external feedback
abstract: This paper presents the results of experimental studies of the main modes of the generators of microwave chaotic oscillations with internal electronic and external feedback. We consider pulse and continuous modes. It is experimentally established that the considered generators of noise-like oscillations have ultra-wide band of generation. Statistical properties of generated signals have been illustrated. We present promising areas of application for considered ultra-wideband microwave sources.

articleTitle: Investigation of process of alignment of flexible antenna by means of stepping motor drive
abstract: The mathematical model for investigation of process of pointing of spatial antenna by means of stepping motor drive is offered. The model allows analyzing of dynamics of antenna drive with the accounting of the elastic strain of its structure and interference of control channels. It is shown, that in some cases, elastic vibrations of antenna might influence substantially on the functioning of the drive of pointing.

articleTitle: Ukrainian part in organization and work of CriMiCo conferences (1991–2010)
abstract: Analyzed in this paper is participation of Ukrainian scientists and specialists in organization and work of International Crimean Conferences “Microwave & Telecommunication Technology” in 1991-2010, taking into consideration four aspects: publications, participation in committees' work (personalia of 39 scientists and specialists), organization of committees' work in Kiev, contribution of Ukrainian female scientists into the Conference development. The method of bibliometric analysis was used.

articleTitle: The effect of abnormal augmentation of anode current in diode structures
abstract: The theoretical and experimental voltage-ampere characteristics (VACH) for the cylindrical diodes are taken and analyzed. The effect of spontaneous growth of anode current when U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> >U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sup> has been observed.

articleTitle: Computer-based investigation of dependence of efficiency of coaxial gyro-BWO on oscillating frequency
abstract: In this article we obtained enhancement of efficiency of gyro-BWO from ~10% up to ~20% due to profiled guiding magnetic field at oscillation frequency f=(7.7-10)GHz and energy injection of an electron beam γ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 2.

articleTitle: The relationship between the minimal ferromagnetic resonance frequency and the shape and quantity of the ferrite inserts in nonreciprocal passive devices
abstract: Dependence of ferromagnetic resonance minimum frequency vs. the shape and quantity of the ferrite inserts used in unilateral passive devices is studied. By example of one and two ferrite disks the difference in ferromagnetic resonance minimum available frequency is shown.

articleTitle: Subject ontologies in the general and regional historiography of radio technology development
abstract: In the report with use of the history and typological approach the principles of formation of subject ontologies (of scientific results, science divisions, objects under study, research methods) for a portal of knowledge on the general and regional historiography of radio technologies development are offered.

articleTitle: Retraction Notice: Mechanisms of influence of MM-waves on development physiology of fitosistems
abstract: The possibilities of compensation of defects of development of phytosystems due to the bioenergetic influence of different external fields, in particular the electromagnetic fields (EMP) of necessary frequency range and optimum power on their internal biological field. The effect of influence of AMY KVCH on development of plants has been observed at the seeds which were saved more than 10 years. The results of analysis of mechanisms of mutual influence of biological fields in addition to the energetic aspect confirm the potency of translation of genetic traits of one cellular structure into the other.

articleTitle: In blessed memory of Lev Ivanovich Tsvetkov
abstract: A brief biography of Lev Ivanovich Tsvetkov is given highlighting his professional achievements.

articleTitle: Switchable bulk acoustic wave resonator based on ferroelectric films
abstract: The calculation of eigen acoustic modes of multilayer microwave capacitance structure with thin ferroelectric films in paraelectric state is carried out. For estimation of excitation efficiency of bulk acoustic waves (BAW) by ferroelectric films the system of electromechanical equations is solved and spatial distribution of mechanical displacements in the structure is presented. Finally, the switchability of eigen acoustic modes for novel switchable BAW resonator is discussed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic properties of metallic photonic crystals
abstract: The dispersion equation construction and homogenization methods for metallic photonic crystals have been considered and developed. The results are obtained.

articleTitle: Fractal mode of distribution of surface potential of gate layer in gallium arsenide structure of field-effect transistor
abstract: On account of fractal nature (D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>=2.62) of the gate layer of FET, instrumental characteristics, when length and width of the gate are reduced, will change disproportionally to square of change of linear dimensions of the gate (versus two-dimensional case) and noticeably slower - in proportion to changing of linear dimensions to the power of 4-D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>, where 2<;;D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub><;;3. The fractal nature of the surface potential of the gate layer might be caused by either fractal distribution of ionized donor impurity in the bulk and at its surface or by fractal distribution of charged adsorbing ions.

articleTitle: The coaxial resonator measuring converter for microwave aquimetry
abstract: Numerical modeling of the coaxial resonator measuring converter with an evanescent waveguide is carried out.

articleTitle: Improvement in quality of coverage of 802.11a/b/g wireless networks
abstract: The principle of optimization of coverage of Wi-Fi networks by application of beamforming technology and SDMA is considered.

articleTitle: Problem of generation of MANET control system
abstract: The problem of generation of MANET control system is considered. The model of MANET control system consisting in the development of the methods of operative management and coordination of their interaction according to the control functions and to the levels of OSI model is offered.

articleTitle: Hybrid method of estimation of influence of structural inhomogeneities on protectivie properties of electromagnetic screen
abstract: The method of creation of 3D hybrid numerical-analytical models of electromagnetic screens, containing inhomogeneities of types, "orifice" and "chink" has been developed. The customized software for solution of the analytical part of the hybrid model with by means of advanced method has been worked out. The comparative analysis of efficiency of 3D hybrid and numerical models with structural inhomogeneities has been conducted.

articleTitle: Compositional analysis of semicondactive solid solutions of type CZT for application in SHF systems
abstract: The changes in composition of solid solutions CdZnTe are investigated by the method of energy dispersive analysis by scanning electron microscope PEM - 106.

articleTitle: Standard technologies for microvawe semiconductor electronics based on III-nitrides
abstract: The 0.8 mkm AlGaN based process is realized to create power transistors suitable for design of microwave amplifiers with working frequencies up to C-band. Newly developed 0.5 mkm- process is expected to extend technology applicability towards X-band RF-devices.

articleTitle: Dispatching of satellite networks in planned range eutelsat B-36E and UKRSAT-BSS-38,2-G-1
abstract: In this article the problem of coordination of satellite networks UKRSAT-BSS-38, 2-G-1 and EUTELSAT B-36E is considered, the augmentation of equivalent noise temperature of the satellite system EUTELSAT B-36E, as a result of interference from UKRSAT-BSS-38, 2-G-1 system, is calculated, mechanisms of achievement of dispatching between the networks are analyzed, some practical recommendations are stated.

articleTitle: Fractals, fractional operators and scaling basis of new methods of processing, and synthesis of fractal radio systems, antennas and impedances
abstract: It is presented how the new synergetic approach on the basis of fractional measuring, fractal dimension, scaling, fractals and deterministic chaos has been developed in IREE RAS as applied to problems of modern nonlinear radio physics and radio engineering since the eighties of XX century. Researches have been traditionally performed in the framework of modern fundamental interdisciplinary project “Fractal radiophysics and radio electronics: Radio systems designing”, that was proposed and being investigated in Institute of Radio Engineering and Electronics of the RAS for the purpose of progress informational technologies developing. The main steps of the Moscow School of Fractal Methods led by the author are presented.

articleTitle: The method of experimental modeling of Cherenkov and diffraction radiations on the periodic metal-dielectric structures
abstract: The general method of experimental modeling of Cherenkov and diffraction radiations on the periodic structures is presented. The scheme of an experimental setting for millimeter range is realized and results of test measurements are obtained.

articleTitle: Study of resistance of low-noise amplifier based on GaN PHEMT, to input microwave power
abstract: Development and practical realization results of low noise amplifiers robust to input microwave power are presented. The measured parameters are shown.

articleTitle: Balancing of wave E01 reflection from dielectric window on horn aperture
abstract: The effective method of calculation of symmetric E-waves of a round irregular waveguide is offered. Computations of radiant reflectance of a horn with a dielectric window on the aperture are carried out. At the expense of a correct choice of parameters such conditions at which balancing of wave reflection is realized, are found.

articleTitle: UWB chaotic generator on Si-Ge transistor
abstract: Results of simulation and experimental investigation of UWB chaotic generator are presented. As it is shown, such generator can be built on lumped elements and it can produce stable chaotic oscillations in the band 0.5-16 GHz at -10 dB level with efficiency ~5%.

articleTitle: Hardware-software complex for research of absorption spectrum of blood in decimetre band
abstract: The breadboard model of the hardware-software complex for research of the absorption spectrum of blood in the decimetre band has been developed and produced.

articleTitle: 3D electromagnetic simulation of low-voltage generator on virtual cathode with feedback
abstract: 3D electromagnetic simulation is used to study generator on a virtual cathode with feedback (FB). Implementation of FB through the input cavity in a double-stream mode provides premodulation of an electron beam that magnifies the overall performance of the device. The electromagnetic FB between input and output cavities provides changing of the intensity and frequency structure of oscillations of the vircator. Under certain conditions chaotization and amplification of HF oscillations induced in the output cavity is possible.

articleTitle: Investigation of properties of chaotic maps
abstract: In the present report properties of sequences generated by chaotic maps are investigated. The comparative analysis of characteristics of sequences generated by linear systems with properties of sequences, generated by chaotic maps was carried out.

articleTitle: Construction and optimization of LTE networks
abstract: The new design features of mobile communication are described. The LTE technology transceiver for a “downlink” line for frequency division duplex of channel with fading is considered. The scheme showing dependence of the signal - noise ratio for different kinds of modulation is considered.

articleTitle: GaAs power limiters MMIC
abstract: The results of experimental investigation of the broadband GaAs power limiter MMIC with small insertion losses have been presented.

articleTitle: Circuit multiplexers of 6- and 10-GHz multistandard transciver based on LCP and LTCC
abstract: The modeling results for three-port multiplexer (MUX) based on microstrip coupled lines (MCL) are presented. This MUX is adapted for two communication standards. The obtained characteristics of pass-bands show a multiplexer operation in ranges of 5.75 ... 5.95 GHz and 9.95 ... 10.15 GHz in one transmit direction, and also 6.25 ... 6.45 GHz and 10.45 ... 10.65 GHz in other transmit direction. Results of modeling of 10-GHz LTCC-filter, based on helical inductors (HI) as a variant of alternative realization of strip filters for compact multiplexers of SHA range, are presented.

articleTitle: Resonance cubic lattice of spherical air-filled bubbles located in magnetodielectric medium
abstract: The solution and analysis of a problem are considered concerning plane wave scattering by a resonance cubic lattice of spherical air-filled bubbles located in magnetodielectric medium.

articleTitle: Hybrid satellite orbits (HSO) for global coverage
abstract: The Hybrid satellite constellation can be configured by several types of combinations between existing orbital solutions today, such as an integration of GEO (Geostationary Earth Orbit) with HEO (Highly Elliptical Orbit), PEO (Polar Earth Orbit) or LEO (Low Earth Orbit) constellations, and integration of MEO (Medium earth Orbit) with HEO or LEO. Namely, any of these combinations can provide better global coverage for Northern and Southern Hemispheres, including both Polar Regions. In this context will be introduced shortly five hybrid constellation systems, which are currently using or developing for MSS (Mobile Satellite Systems) communication, distress alerting, safety and security and navigation systems.

articleTitle: Formation of stable nanodimensional magnetic FePt films for high density magnetic recording and information storage
abstract: Phase composition, microstructure and magnetic properties of nanodimensional film compositions (NFC) of Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>Pt<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(100 nm)/Si(001) after deposition and annealings in nitrogen atmosphere and vacuum were studied.

articleTitle: The influence of transversal electron on the condition of vibration stimulation in the amplifier on the Smith-Parcel effect
abstract: The degree of influence of the transversal electronic waves on the process of energy exchange of electrons with the field of open waveguide is defined by means of comparative analysis of approximate dispersion equation of the amplifier model on the Smith-Parcel effect.

articleTitle: Effect of profile of external focusing magnetostatic field on output characteristics of DRG (LMN) in frequency range 50–80 GHz
abstract: A breadboard model of a new source of high-stable oscillations - diffraction radiation generator (DRG) with local magnetostatic non-uniformity (LMN) in the interaction space - has been developed. DRG (LMN) operates in the wide frequency range with enhanced frequency stability. Output power is 8W (and more) at accelerating voltage up to 2.5kV in the continuous mode, and it is quite stable to variations of the profile of the external focusing magnetostatic field (FMF).

articleTitle: Calculation of current-voltage characteristics of a ballistic transistor based on metallic single-wall carbon nanotube
abstract: The physico-mathematical model of coherent electron transport in a metallic single-wall carbon nanotube ballistic transistor is developed. The model is based on a numerical solution of stationary wave equation for electrons in the nanotube by a finite-difference method. The current-voltage characteristics of such transistor are calculated.

articleTitle: Sol-gel synthesis of phosphores for green range: Photo-, cathodo-and under X-ray luminescence
abstract: Willemite (α-Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) doped with manganese and Tb-doped yttrium alumina garnets (Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.85</sub> Tb <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.15</sub> Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>), were synthesized using sol-gel technique. Photo-, cathodoluminescence and luminescence under X-ray excitation were investigated and under all types of excitation the samples revealed green visible to the naked eye luminescence at room temperature.

articleTitle: Changes in human cell membrane permeability after irradiation by microwaves with different elliptical polarization
abstract: Isolated human buccal epithelium cells were irradiated by microwaves of frequency f=36.64 GHz, surface power density E = 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, and 1 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, exposure time 10 s. The state of cell membranes was evaluated by the method of vital indigo-carmine and trypan blue staining. The percentage of unstained cells after irradiation at E = 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 1 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> decreased as a result of the microwave radiation exposure indicating an increase in cell damage or death. The left-hand polarized radiation caused greater cellular damage than the right-hand polarized radiation.

articleTitle: Information resources rating increasing technique
abstract: The work concerns investigation of the algorithms for the automated determination of web-based information resources rating. It is based on the analysis of changes in the algorithms of search engines search queries results of late five years. The report also considers the developed technique of the Internet web sites rating improving.

articleTitle: System of generating of speechlike signals for masking of acoustic information
abstract: The structure of the system of generating of "speechlike" signals for active protection of acoustic information through masking has been developed. The algorithm of speech detection has been found and formulated. Methods of speech segmentation have been analyzed.

articleTitle: Two-phase identification of cognitive models of dm preference system for information reflexive systems
abstract: Considered is two-stage method of identification of fuzzy cognitive models of preferences systems of the decision maker (DM PS) for information reflexive systems. At the first stage optimization and non-optimization methods were used, while at the second stage we used the methods of inverse problem.

articleTitle: Influence of reflecting load in research of structure of electromagnetic field in transmission line
abstract: Analysis of different shapes of the curve of ferromagnetic resonance in the process of investigation of a structure of electromagnetic field of a transmission line with unmatched load was carried out. By example of analytical study of a ferrite resonator in the evanescent waveguide it was shown that amplitude of magnetic field strength of right-hand circular polarization in the location area of a measuring probe had corresponded to total deviation of the curve of ferromagnetic resonance versus unperturbed value.

articleTitle: Microwave sensors for registration of ionizing radiation
abstract: The development of contactless semiconductor microwave-biased detectors (microwave SMD) for registration of ionizing radiations will allow overcoming a number of technological restrictions inherent to traditional SMD, simplifying a design, raising reliability and efficiency of the detector. The price of such solution is some complication of signal extraction and processing of a primary signal at high frequencies. The purpose of work is to offer an adequate radiophysical methods and means for radiometry of ionizing particles. In the work the criteria of choice of a frequency range and development of designs of effective microwave resonant sensor for detecting ionizing radiations are proved on the basis of an analysis of the factor of efficiency.

articleTitle: Main principles of use of coherent population trapping for modulation and demodulation of multifrequency radiation
abstract: The basic principles of physical effect of coherent population trapping (CPT) were studied as a basis for the development of devices for modulation and demodulation of multi-frequency radiation into the modern DWDM (dense wavelength-division multiplexing) systems that will significantly increase the volume of transmitted data.

articleTitle: Research of glass materials of micromechanical elements for VHF-devices
abstract: Results of research of glass materials of micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) for VHF devices are submitted.

articleTitle: Construction approach of integrated remote sensing systems based on the partial channels
abstract: The principles of construction and technical implementation of multichannel integrated remote sensing systems based on the separate channels which work at splitted spectral bands were developed.

articleTitle: Investigation of narrowband filters parameters using Simulink
abstract: Simulation of a wireless system using the detector, modified by a system of RRC filters, was carried out. The influence of parameters on the quality of detection of phase-manipulated signals was investigated.

articleTitle: Medium and high altitude orbits
abstract: A communication satellite in Medium and High Altitude Orbits must be visible from the regions concerned during the period when it is desired to provide a links for Fixed (FSS) and Mobile Satellite Service (MSS), what can vary from a few to 24 hours per day. These kinds of orbits are circular and are in function to cover a given geographical region at the same local time each day and to offer continuous service to all Mobile (MES), Fixed (FES) and Land Earth Stations (LES). The duration of uninterrupted communication service, which such satellite can provide in any region on the terrestrial surface, is a function of his altitude and latitude of the satellite FSS or MSS receivers or transceivers. The most popular and used type of the Medium and High Altitude Orbits today is well known Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) for both FSS and MSS applications with coverage between 75° N and S latitude. The GEO constellation cannot provide coverage for both Polar Regions. On the other hand, Highly Inclined Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) today is mostly in use for Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), such as first generation of GNSS-1, both military systems, the US GPS and Russian GLONASS. This orbit is also suitable for the European second generation GNSS-2 civilian Galileo system. The Geosynchronous Inclined Orbit (GIO) can be also successfully implemented for GNSS and satellite communication purposes, but is not suitable for covering Polar Regions.

articleTitle: Packaged DRG of continuous oscillations of increased power of frequency range 30–100 GHz
abstract: The output characteristics of breadboard models of diffraction radiation generators with a chain of coupled resonators DRG (CCR) of the frequency range 30-100 GHz with output power more than 20W and accelerating voltage up to 3.6 kV in the continuous mode with satisfactory quality of a signal spectrum are presented.

articleTitle: Chaos in systems of microwave frequencies
abstract: The method of establishment of chaotic generators in the microwave range on the basis of one-transistor amplifier is offered. The models of description of dynamics and the results of experimental researches of such systems are presented.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental investigations of submillimeter CW gyrotrons in IAP RAS
abstract: The paper presents an overview of research activity for development of relatively low-power (10-100 W) submillimeter CW gyrotrons at the IAP RAS The design of CW IAP RAS gyrotrons on the second harmonic of gyrofrequency in the range 0.2-0.8 THz is discussed in this paper. The choosing of the operating mode was made basing on the one hand at the density of the parasitic mode spectrum, especially on the fundamental harmonic and on the other hand on possibility of formation of the electron beam in a magnetron injection gun. Optimization of the cavity profile for these gyrotrons was made and the maximum efficiency for reasonable accelerating voltage from 5 kV to 20 kV and current of the electron beam up to 1 A was determined. The main results of these calculations are presented in table 1. Also for these gyrotrons the influence of parasitic modes at the fundamental and second harmonics of the cyclotron frequency was investigated. One of these devices -0.26 THz gyrotron was developed, manufactured and tested at IAP RAS. The maximum CW output power of 200 W for accelerating voltage 16 kV and beam current 0.3 A was obtained at the experimental tests. During more than 8 hours CW operation tests at the customer's site (BRMZ of Frankfurt University) the frequency and power stability of 5*10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> and 1 % respectively was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photocatalytic application of titanium oxide formed by sol-gel method in porous anodic alumina
abstract: The synthesis of titanium dioxide in the pores of porous anodic alumina (PAA) membrane was realized by solgel method. The samples were used for test reaction of degradation of organic dye rhodamine B. The synthesized samples of titanium oxide xerogel in the membrane of porous anodic alumina are considered as effective photocatalyst for decomposition of organic dyes in aqueous medium.

articleTitle: The high-order optimal design of experiment development on the base of regular simplex for the slow-wave structures characteristics modeling
abstract: The results of optimal Simplex-Sum Design of experiment development method are presented. Such Designs are assigned for the numerical or physical experimental modeling of the waveguide systems electrodynamics characteristics using high-order polynomials.

articleTitle: Argumentation of growth velocity of monocrystals bismuth-antimony by method of floating-zone refining
abstract: The question of growth of perfect bismuth-antimony monocrystals with uniform distribution of Sb atoms throughout the crystal by the method of floating-zone refining is considered.

articleTitle: Classification of the next generation grid systems
abstract: Current grids' architecture is the third-generation one. It doesn't meet the requirements of next-generation grids (NGG). The overview of the NGG and its classification, which completely meets the requirements of this rapidly developing field, is presented in the article.

articleTitle: Analysis of social networks implementation in scope of business environment
abstract: Nowadays social networks are effective tools for expressing various semantic relations between people and enterprises. The basis of any social service is a communication platform in which users can express their thoughts, communicate with each other, establishing new relationships and identifying their interests. These resources represent a structured on a certain set of characteristic audience: the majority of users are united by a common professional or personal interest.

articleTitle: Deadlock and blocking factors in three-node telecommunication networks with priority feedback
abstract: The study presented in this manuscript is motivated by the performance analysis of three-node telecommunication networks with HOL priority feed backed service, deadlock and blocking. This model is based on the performance of the Markovian three-node queuing network with finite capacity buffers, for which new and practical results are provided. Here, a two-dimensional state graph is constructed and set of steady-state equations is created. These equations allow for calculating state probabilities for each graph state. The results of investigation allow the definition of the region where the model is useful and where the desired QoS is satisfied.

articleTitle: Current status, attempts of implementation, technological development of on-air broadcasting of standard DVB-T
abstract: On the basis of current status of tecnologies of broadcasting it is shown that the method of information gaining by means of surface-mounted off-the-air networks is the most effective instrument of implementation of the systems of multifunction information service and integration of digital processing allows realizing of principally new approach to the television broadcasting. The single-frequency areas of synchronous broadcasting of standard DVB-T with the use of traffic currents of modulations MPEG-4, KAM-64 are considered. The results of complex investigations and the operation and maintenance of developed in Ukraine, implemented and put into production domestic radio tuner “Meridian”, digital transmitters and receiving antennas are submitted. The development trends of technologies of digital air brodcasting have been analized.

articleTitle: The environment model for integrated corporative systems functioning support
abstract: A generalized environment model for integrated corporative systems (ICS) functioning support is suggested for its application for ICS modeling. Its basic concepts are specified. Extensible document model (EDM) and business process (BP) models are suggested for realization of enterprise informational and functional infrastructures development, their analysis and improvement.

articleTitle: Q-factor of microstrip resonators with high dielectric substrates
abstract: The experimental researches of microstrip resonators on the substrates with inductivity ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> = 80; 38 have been carried out (thickness of the substrate is 1 mm).

articleTitle: Electrodynamical model for open resonator with dielectric bead
abstract: The present work is devoted to development of an approximate mathematical model and theoretical treatment of an open resonator, consisting of spherical and flat reflectors. In the center of a flat reflector a segment of oversize circular waveguide with a dielectric bead is located.

articleTitle: Characteristics of application of impulse reflectometry in investigation of ultra-wideband circuits
abstract: Features of impulse reflectometry of the sub-nanosecond range are considered. The influence of parameters of a probing signal in the ultrabroadband nonuniform systems on the results of measurements is analyzed. An algorithm of processing of measurement data that allows accounting of the shape of the probing signal and numerous reflections, originating from nonuniform systems, is proposed.

articleTitle: Features of formation of active areas of n-p-n-transistors for submicronic integrated microcircuits
abstract: Formation of active areas of n-p-n-transistors for submicronic integrated microcircuits was investigated at scaling carrying out. It was shown, that reduction of energy and doze of base doping allows increasing a direct coefficient of amplification of n-p-n-transistor and reducing amount of RTA processes. An optimum mode of emitter doping for reception of necessary values of direct coefficient of current amplification of n-p-n-transistor is use of the doping doze 600 μC/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at energy of P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ions 20–30 keV.

articleTitle: Measurement of Specific Absorption Rate in near-field zone of electromagnetic field
abstract: Main principles of measuring of SAR (Specific Absorption Rate) in the near-field zone of the electromagnetic field are considered.

articleTitle: Matlab-technology for devices modeling in radar-location
abstract: Motion direction determination of objects by means of radio aids is based on rectilinear propagation of radio waves in a homogeneous medium and thus requires determination of the arrival direction of radio waves emitted or reflected from objects, by comparing the amplitude, phase or frequency of vibrations excited in the antenna system.

articleTitle: Limit bitrates of information transmission for the ultrawideband direct chaotic communication system in multipath channels
abstract: Bitrate performance of a wireless communication scheme with ultrawideband chaotic radiopulses in multipath channels is evaluated. The channels based on indoor multipath channel models elaborated by IEEE 802.15.4a working group for ultrawideband wireless communication systems are considered. Error probability vs. bitrates is numerically estimated.

articleTitle: Improving the efficiency of submillimeter gyrotrons by using various electrodynamic systems
abstract: At present, interest to submillimeter devices, has been strengthened since this frequency range is attractive for numerous applications, which include plasma diagnostics, electron-spin resonance spectroscopy, enhancement of NMR sensitivity using dynamic nuclear polarization, standoff detection and imaging of explosives and weapons, new medical technology, atmospheric monitoring, chemical technologies, production of high-purity materials, deep space and specialized satellite communication etc. One of these devices is a gyrotron. The main problems of gyrotron optimization and development are mode competition between operating and parasitic modes and wideband frequency tuning. In this paper, some types of electrodynamic systems for creating submillimeter gyrotrons are investigated. For gyrotrons with the two-mirror cavity the possibility of wideband frequency tuning (50%), with and maintaining high efficiency (about 1%) is shown. Also the 2 THz gyrotron based on the using couple cavity was presented. Optimization of the cavity and the problem of mode selection were investigated and its efficiency were estimated.

articleTitle: A 2–4 GHz 25W and 50W GaN power amplifiers
abstract: Results of design and experimental investigations of two models (25W and 50W) 2–4 GHz GaN-based amplifiers are presented in this article.

articleTitle: Microstrip antennas for small size modules of GNSS's signal receiving
abstract: A microstrip antenna (MSA) design problems and their solving are described. The dependences of electrical antenna parameters of construction are researched. The MSA of different purpose are designed and launched in serial production to use in global navigation satellite systems (GNSS).

articleTitle: On the analysis of the structure of intense electron beam on transition radiation
abstract: A method of processing and analyzing the results of the study of axially symmetric static electron beams on the transition radiation has been developed. On the basis of the received algorithms, a computer program, which allows simplifying and expediting significantly the processing of digital photos, has been compiled.

articleTitle: Digital frequency meter of microwave range
abstract: Microwave frequency meters of a new generation of UA CH3-63 / 3, UA CH3-64 / 2, UA CH3-79M, UA CH3-101 are developed. The design of devices is given and their advantages in comparison with domestic equivalents are presented.

articleTitle: Versatile new generation muzzle velocity radar
abstract: The results of compact MMW muzzle velocity radar development and research are presented. The radar is intended to measure the speed of shells and mortar shells of 20 to 200 mm caliber within 50 to 2000 m/s.

articleTitle: The equivalent circuit parameters calculation of a coupled cavity chain using electrodynamic characteristics
abstract: The results of development of the methodology of equivalent circuits' parameters calculation of a coupled cavity chain using electrodynamic characteristics are presented. The methodology applying has shown significant errors (of the parameters determining) reduction in comparison with other known methods.

articleTitle: Hemispherical dielectric resonator with concentric hemispherical hollow for liquid dielectrics investigations
abstract: A new measuring cell is suggested in order to investigate dielectric properties of liquids with great losses.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic identification of dental materials
abstract: The electromagnetic features and parameters of dental materials were investigated to compare and identify with natural tissues.

articleTitle: Schedule design for multiprocessor systems
abstract: This article is devoted to the part of this process - schedule design as an example of software development for LTE and WIMAX base stations.

articleTitle: Technique and accuracy appraisal of extraction of MHEMT small-signal equivalent circuit
abstract: The new reliable and accurate technique of extraction of small-signal model of microwave FETs is proposed. The influence of measurement errors on accuracy of extracted parameters of mHEMT small-signal model is calculated.

articleTitle: State of ukrainian frequency-orbital resources
abstract: The condition and problems of realization of the NSSC frequency-orbital resources declared by Administration of Communication and National Space Agency of Ukraine are considered. UKRSAT-BSS-38.2E-G-I satellite network has been declared and UKR00001 assignment is published. Completion of the international coordination of satellite networks UKRSAT-KA-38.2E and UKRSAT-BSS-38.2E-G-I will allow providing with a frequency-orbital resource (ranges X, Ku, KA) the space station established in an orbital position 38.2 ° of east longitude.

articleTitle: Oscillatory processes in gas discharge with overcritical beam current
abstract: Within the limits of two dimensional numeric model physical processes of oscillations of virtual cathode in drift space, filled with neutral gas, are investigated.

articleTitle: Investigation of features of sensing of video information in telecommunication systems
abstract: The study of features of sensing of video information from a monitor was carried out. The account of characteristics of ocular movements in the process of perception of video information in telecommunication systems allows developing of more effective information technologies, considering features of cognitive processes.

articleTitle: Some aspects of the analysis of functioning NGN network based on semi-Markov processes
abstract: The present paper concerns the application of semi-Markov processes to analyze the operation of NGN networks (Next Generation Network).

articleTitle: Measurement of electromagnetic fields of sub-nanosecond impulses in coaxial waveguides
abstract: The characteristics of measurements of parameters of impulses of the subnanosecond range in the coaxial waveguides by capacitive dividers of different type are considered. Advantages of application of dividers with partial integration and procedure of subsequent numerical restoration of initial impulse are showed.

articleTitle: Technology of adjustment of PAA with wide-angle scan
abstract: This report submits the practical approach to the initial alignment of the phased-array antennas (PAA) with the wide-angle scan which ensures PAA performances close to potentially accessible. The conditions and methods required for PAA initial adjustment, measurements, automatic diagnostics and performance monitoring are described. Some practical aspects of technology of alignment taking into account constructive peculiarities of PAA, measurement restrictions and results of simulation and the real measurements are presented to demonstrate the utility of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: To 60th anniversary of Professor Batura Mikhail Pavlovich
abstract: DIscusses the 60th anniversary of Professor Batura Mikhail Pavlovich.

articleTitle: Scattering of the Gaussian beam by a metamaterial slab
abstract: Scattering regularities of the Gaussian beam on the metamaterial slab with negative and imaginary refractive index are investigated. Theoretical analysis is carried out on the base of method of plane-wave spectral decomposition and synthesis. Regimes of the electromagnetic field propagation in the slab are considered for different system parameter values.

articleTitle: Impact of Schottky contacts on forward and reverse saturation currents
abstract: It has been found that the screening electric field E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> located at the periphery of the metal-semiconductor contact with Schottky barrier and penetrating to the contact, depends on contact diameter D and prevents electrons from direct motion, as well as strengthens the electric field of the contact. The impact of E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> on forward-bias regions of volt-ampere characteristic results in almost total absence of forward currents at low (U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub><;0.35 V) forward biases. At U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>>0.35 V the built-in electric field is compensated by the external electric field, while the volt-ampere characteristic curve takes its normal form. The impact of the built-in field on reverse-bias regions of voltampere characteristic results in significant effective decrease in height of a potential barrier by value φ* through reduction in its width near the vertex and significant increase in field electron emission. This results in significant (up to five orders of magnitude) increase in reverse saturation currents in relation to saturation currents.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of structure of magnon crystals
abstract: In this report the results of theoretical research of propagation characteristics of surface magnetostatic waves in periodic one-dimensional magnon crystals are presented.

articleTitle: Characteristic properties of forming of virtual cathode in canular relativistic electron beam
abstract: Processes of forming of the virtual cathode (VC) in the canular relativistic electron beam (REB) in the external magnetic field are analyzed numerically with the help of 3D electromagnetic model. It was discovered that dynamics of VC in the system is determined by the value of external magnetic field and by the features of physical processes in the REB.

articleTitle: Modeling of submillimetric magnetron on the first positive space harmonic of Π-mode oscilastions
abstract: The characteristics of a submillimetric-wave cold-cathode magnetron oscillator (SubMMO) operating on the first positive spatial π-mode oscillation harmonic are analytically modeled using the drift-orbital resonances and 3-D simulation. The results of this procedure are presented in the short report below. The distinguishing features of the nonlinear dynamics of electron-wave interaction between synchronous electrons and electromagnetic field. It is shown that using such a magnetron makes it possible generate pulses with HF-power magnitude varying from hundreds of mWs to tens of Watts.

articleTitle: The study of the processes of virtual cathode formation in the helical electron flow under the influence of the beam space charge
abstract: The numerical study of the virtual cathode (VC) formation in the tubular helical electron flow formed by a magnetron-injection gun (MIG) in the mode of small pitch-factor under the influence of space charge is carried out.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic emission and living organisms
abstract: On the basis of experimental measurements of time change of conductivity of water the response of the system "water - the population of protozoans " on influence of electromagnetic radiation of centimeter and millimeter range of wavelengths is considered.

articleTitle: Optimization of screen aspect ratio of slow-wave curcuit of type rings on opposed metal poles for increasing of coupling impedance
abstract: The results of optimization of the form and dimensions of the screen as well as height of poles of slow-wave circuit of a type rings on the opposed towers for the purpose of increasing of coupling impedance and control of the dispersion characteristic without the change in the form and sizes of interaction gap are presented.

articleTitle: Nitride gallium high power integrated heterostructure FETs
abstract: The heterostructures AlGaN/AlN/GaN, grown on sapphire substrates, the standard design of the integrated power HFET and the design with the additional field-plate, and its technology have been developed. The HFETs have given output power 4,5-5,5 and 3-4 W/mm, and power gain 4,5-7,5 N 3,8-6,0 dB at frequencies 12 and 17,5 GHz.

articleTitle: Quality diagnostics of nonlinear models of elements at baseband pulse signals
abstract: It is shown that an approach included investigation of the nonlinearity characteristics of signals transformation by an element is preferable to quality diagnostics of nonlinear models of elements. The software tools and measuring device which allow carrying out such diagnostics for baseband pulse signals are specified.

articleTitle: Magnetically inhomogeneous state in Sr2FeMoO6.δ metal oxide compound
abstract: It is determined that the state of initial reagents considerably influence the inhomogeneity of Sr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>FeMoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6-δ</inf> samples microstructure which has caused the appearance of super-paramagnetism and spin glass state in Sr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>FeMoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6-δ</inf>.

articleTitle: Cylindrical antenna for circular polarization
abstract: The possibility of a cylindrical antenna to creation of required radiation field of circular polarization is studied. There are several models of antenna and the results of investigation their characteristics are presented.

articleTitle: Cylindrical spiral antenna with variable angle of winding turns
abstract: The paper shows the results of study of cylindrical helical antenna with a variable angle of winding turns. The expressions of calculation of radiation characteristics of a spiral radiator, the results of computation of radiation characteristics and input characteristics in the frequency range of 2,5 … 4 GHz have shown that the developed antenna has high ellipticity throughout the frequency range and stable input resistance.

articleTitle: Prediction of presence of communication on intervals of digital line-of-sight radio-relay systems
abstract: A method, an algorithm and software for prediction of presence of communication on intervals of digital line-of-sight radio-relay systems are developed. The method for known characteristics of radio means and propagation parameters calculates factor of unavailability of an interval and severely erroneous second ratio and compares them to the normalized values. The method takes into account a signal fading caused by a subrefraction of radio waves, by a multipath beams spreading, by a precipitations, by atmospheric gases and water vapours.

articleTitle: Measuring instrument of complex factor of millimetric wave band reflection on basis of 12-ports circuit
abstract: Principles of construction of two-detector measuring instrument of complex factor of reflection on basis of dual six-port are developed. The prototype transmitter is designed and manufactured. Calibration technique for the measuring instrument is developed and relations for determination of parameters of elements being studied and analysis of measuring errors are obtained.

articleTitle: Low noise amplifiers with built-in protection of input stages for frequency fange 3–8 GHz
abstract: The results of a design of low noise amplifiers with built-in protection of input stages operating in the frequency range 3.0-8.0 GHz are presented. LNA have been developed on the basis of “NPP ”Planeta-Argall”. LNA might be applied in the design of communication equipment, radar stations, radars and detectors of radiation.

articleTitle: Ballistic transport in triple-barrier structures in two frequency electric field
abstract: For asymmetric triple-barrier resonant-tunneling structures with thin and high (delta) barriers, the closed form of solution of Schrödinger equation describing the resonant transitions between three quantum levels in the single-frequency high electric field has been generalized for the case of double-frequency field. It is shown that for each structure there are conditions when the majority of electrons falling on the upper energy level might emit two photons and then leave the structure without intermediate electron-phonon interaction.

articleTitle: To 75-year anniversary of Igor Vsevolodovich Zvershkhovsky
abstract: DIscusses the 75-year anniversary of Igor Vsevolodovich Zvershkhovsky.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic processes in the electrically active mesosphere
abstract: The MF radar developed for remotely probing the near-Earth space environment and the technique for diagnosing plasma parameters in the electrically active mesosphere have enabled the determination of the basic electrodynamic characteristics of this region, which are required for achieving the fundamental physical understanding and can be used in practical applications (Sun-Earth connections, modeling the ionosphere as well as natural and anthropogenic global disturbances, near-Earth environment monitoring, earthquake predictions, and radio propagation forecasting). In particular, the average daily electric fields intrinsic to the mesosphere have been determined for the first time.

articleTitle: Teoretical discription of transformation function of adsorption microwave hygrometers
abstract: The analytical description of the electromagnetic field in resonators with moisture absorption inserts is created. Variation in time of spatial distribution of the adsorbed moisture is taken into account. Results of numerical calculations of parameters of the resonator sensor with different forms and dimensions of moisture absorption inserts are obtained and analyzed. Practical value of results and prospects of further perfection of the given type of microwave sensors is shown.

articleTitle: Circular polarized dualband microstrip antenna for application in GLONASS/GPS
abstract: The results of computer simulation of two-layer antenna right circular polarization for applications in satellite navigation systems GLONASS / GPS on the frequency bands L1 and L2 are demonstrated. The influence of passive elements in the design of the antenna on the band of working frequencies is investigated.

articleTitle: Chaotic dissipative solitons induced by an external noise signal in a self-oscillating ring with a ferromagnetic film
abstract: The opportunity of non-autonomous chaotic radio pulse (dissipative solitons) generation in a self-oscillating ring with a ferromagnetic film by an external microwave noise influence at different frequencies has been observed for the first time.

articleTitle: Hardware-software complex for remote control of spectrum analyzers SK-4 belan 32, 76, 140, 240, 280, 400
abstract: In this article we describe the system for automated control of spectrum analyzers SK-4 Belan 32, 76, 140, 240, 280, 400. General topics such as necessity and significance of the work are discussed.

articleTitle: Multilayer waveguide based on nanocomposite Al2O3/TiO2
abstract: The alumina waveguide with a nanocomposite Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> core has been developed and fabricated. The refractory index of the nanocomposite was about 1.8. It allowed decreasing the optical losses in the multilayer waveguide up to 0.6 dB/cm.

articleTitle: Node-arc capacity allcation in optical networks with inexact data
abstract: Optical networks are mainly considered as backbones to convey data, voice and video in telecommunication applications by providing considerable bandwidth where quality of service (QoS) sensitive applications rely on bandwidth availability of communications infrastructure. The increasing rate of ICT services over Internet causes a growing bandwidth requests which is a source of demand uncertainty in communication networks. This paper presents a capacity allocation scheme for optical networks in uncertain environments where the traffic information is inexact. The problem is considered as a multi-commodity network problem. The node-arc approach is employed for determining link capacity considering traffic uncertainty.

articleTitle: Some schemes of realization digital FIR filters on FPGA for communication applications
abstract: Realization of digital Finite-Impulse-Response (FIR) filters are so important issues for digital communications and signal processing applications which is the main contribution of this paper. The direct and transposed architectures are employed to implement FIR filters on field-programmable-gate-array (FPGA) using a single SPARTAN 2 chip, XC2S50-5I-tq144, from Xilinx, Inc. The Verilog hardware description language is used for designing different schemes of FIR filter. The effects of coefficient symmetry and implementing multiplier blocks by shift and add operators on frequency and FPGA chip area occupation metrics are studied. Simulation results demonstrate improving FPGA-based solutions for digital FIR filter design.

articleTitle: Dielectric characteristics of thin film capacitors based on anodized Al/Ta layers
abstract: MIM thin film capacitors have been developed with three types of nanostructured thin film dielectrics made from the anodic oxides of Al/Ta metal bilayer. High breakdown voltages, low leakage currents and dielectric losses have been achieved.

articleTitle: UHF characteristics of metal-dielectric nanocomposite materials
abstract: Electrophysical properties of nanocomposite metal-dielectric structures are studied by the example of the aluminum-polymer system in the range of volume parts of metallic phase 0.1–0.6 at a room temperature. The results of microscopic researches are represented.

articleTitle: Using combined electrodynamic methods for analysis of interoperability of local antenna groups
abstract: The article is about using combined electrody-namic methods for analysis of local antenna groups to ensure their in-plant electromagnetic compatibility. Combined methods allow achieving high precision while keeping resources cost fairly low. The description of author's combined method is given. Some numerical results are presented.

articleTitle: Main features of double-diode autodynes and its application
abstract: The results of the autodyne features for double-diode oscillator on Gunn diodes affected by the own reflected signal are presented. The main characteristics of such autodyne are considered oriented to the application in short-range radar systems. The brief description of the autodyne sensor for the determination of the loco movement parameters which is made on the basis of the double-diode autodyne.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic communication — An overview
abstract: The idea of this paper is to give an overview on fiber-optic communication. The most important devices for fiberoptic transmission systems are presented, and their properties discussed. In particular we consider such systems working with those basic components which are necessary to explain the principle of operation. Among them is the optical transmitter, consisting of a light source, typically a high speed driven laser diode. Furthermore, the optical receiver has to be mentioned; it consists of a photodiode and a low noise high bit rate front-end amplifier. Yet, in the focus of the considerations you will find the optical fiber as the dominant element in optical communication systems. Different fiber types are presented, and their properties explained. The joint action of these three basic components leads to fiberoptic systems, mainly applied for data communication. The systems operate as transmission links with bit rates up to 40 Gbit/s and more. Furthermore optical communication systems are also used for recent application areas in the MBit/s region, e.g. in aviation, automobile and maritime industry.

articleTitle: Development of Ka-range magnetron for portable radar
abstract: An experimental prototype of a pulse magnetron has been developed, having the output power of 2.5 kW at a frequency of 35 GHz with the operation voltage of 6.5 kV. The interaction space of the magnetron has been extended due to the properly selected operation mode — it works at the first negative spatial harmonics. The magnetron's structural scheme includes the main secondary-emission cold cathode and an additional side thermoemission cathode. This design provides for a substantial prolongation of magnetron's service life, while the pulse duration and the duty factor increase.

articleTitle: Analysis of the broad-side coupled lines on the vertical substrate using the numerical conformal transformations
abstract: A new model of the broad-side coupled lines on vertical substrate (BCL VS) is developed. It is characterized by high computationally efficiency and sufficient accuracy in practice. This model is added with the optimization procedure, and allows carrying out synthesis and designing of couplers with the design parameters.

articleTitle: Tunable dielectric resonator: Design and parameters
abstract: Dependences of normalized resonance wave-number versus normalized distance between parts of cube, sphere, disk, ring dielectric resonators (DR) and metal-dielectric resonator (MDR) are presented. Influence of resonator's geometry and permittivity on resonant frequency alteration is discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of a liquid crystal tunable phase shifter
abstract: An electrically controlled phase shifter is investigated, which is based on a resonant microstrip structure with a nematic liquid crystal substrate. It is shown that the proposed device can operate in the centimeter and millimeter wavelength range.

articleTitle: Adaptive receivers for explorative UWB pulses
abstract: Adjustment of receiver systems of radar stations to characteristics of reflection of complex radar-tracking targets allows considerable increasing of signal to noise ratio in the process of application of UWB pulses. Methods of signal processing based on measuring of characteristics of reflection and mathematical models of targets are offered.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of influence of microwave radiation on water-oil emulsions
abstract: We show the results of the pilot study of the effect of microwave radiation on the water-oil emulsion functionalized by magnetic nanoparticles - magnetites. It is shown that the addition of magnetic nanoparticles in water emulsion leads to increased absorption of microwave radiation emulsion. Adding magnetic nanoparticles in water-oil emulsion will integrate the resonance and thermal effects contribute to the release of water from water-oil emulsions.

articleTitle: Electron tunneling in the presence of dielectric film on the cathode
abstract: It has been shown theoretically and experimentally that a thin dielectric film on the cathode increases the tunneling emission current.

articleTitle: Gann diodes on basis of variband semiconductors
abstract: The influence of spatial inhomogeneity of different physical parameters of variband semiconductors on origination of inconsistences in Gunn diodes is investigated. Presence of special effects in Gunn diodes on the basis of variband semiconductors is proved. These effects do not exist in diodes on the basis of homogeneous semiconductors. These effects allow increasing of efficiency and oscillation frequency of Gunn diodes.

articleTitle: Arrangement device for monitoring of parameters of microwave resonators
abstract: Results of a design of a gage of Q-factors and resonant frequencies of resonance structures of millimeter range are represented. In the device two variants of measuring are realized: manual-with visual definition of required parameters through oscillogram, and semi-automatic-with digitalization of an information signal and its following program processing and retaining by means of a digital oscilloscope united with a computer.

articleTitle: Cavity methods of investigation of gas and condensed medium in MM AND SubMM ranges
abstract: For MM and SubMM ranges, on the basis of high-quality Fabry-Perot resonator the original precision methods of investigation are discussed: atmospheric absorption, including continuum absorption; radiant reflectance of metals; refraction index and loss tangent of dielectrics, including films and liquids. The methods of measurement are absolute ones and self "calibrated" that means it is not necessary to use the prior information. Concrete values are calculated on the basis of measuring of adjustment frequency and line width of empty and loaded resonator. The temperature range is 80 K-900 K for investigation of condensed medium; for atmospheric — from −30 C up to +60 C and at humidity — 0%–80%. The measurement results of latest polymeric materials are presented.

articleTitle: A 10 VPP SiGe voltage driver
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of the high output swing voltage driver. Designed and fabricated in 0.25 um SiGe BiCMOS technology the driver delivers 10 Vpp output differential voltage swing at 2 Gb/s. The power consumption of the driver is 1.6 W. Measurement results show that the circuit is well suited for processing a bit stream up to 3.4 Gb/s and can be used as a driver for switch-mode amplifiers based on the transistors required high on-voltage.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband direct chaotic wireless communication systems and sensor networks
abstract: The ultrawideband communication facilities where chaotic radio pulses are used as an information carrier are considered. As perspective applications of such systems the wireless sensor networks are discussed.

articleTitle: The rejection filter
abstract: Results of investigation of a design of rejection filter (RF) produced on the basis of inverted strip dielectric waveguide (ISDW) are presented. The structure allows tuning of central frequency in the frequency band up to 10% with 16 ÷ 30 dB variation of attenuation parameter in K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</sub> band.

articleTitle: X-Band narrow-beam antenna for surveillance radar with high resolution at range
abstract: An antenna array (AA) for radar systems with signal bandwidth of 300 MHz was developed. Main AA parameters are: beam width at elevation 270 and at azimuth 10, variation of gain at 9280-9580 MHz band no more than 1.5 dB, parasitic swing of the beam is absent. Intrinsic loss in through AA channel amounts value is close to -1.5 dB, eigen polarization is linear horizontal, side lobe level is less than -25 dB.

articleTitle: Simulation and experimental breadboarding of 35 GHz spatial harmonic magnetrons with cold cathode
abstract: An analytical estimation has been performed to determine the optimal parameters of pulsed magnetrons, operating at a spatial harmonic at a frequency of 35 GHz and an anode voltage of 6.5 kV in the drift-resonance mode, with the main cathode being the cold secondary-emission one. A 3D simulation experiment on a magnetron with the analytically determined characteristics has been conducted to check its adequacy in providing the required energy parameters. The breadboard magnetrons have the number of vane-type resonators in the anode unit N = 20 and N = 16, respectively. The both magnetrons have generated the electromagnetic radiation in the Ka range with the magnetic field being slightly above 0.4 T. It was proven that it is possible to create a full-functional Ka-range magnetron with a relatively low anode voltage and such parameters that enable its wide applicability.

articleTitle: Highly elliptical orbits (HEO) for high latitudes and polar coverage
abstract: The Highly Elliptical Orbit (HEO), contrary to Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO), is projected to cover landmasses of Northern Hemisphere and also the Polar Regions for both Fixed (FSS) and Mobile Satellite Service (MSS). The HEO configuration was chosen by the Soviet Russian Space Authorities for the Molnya and Tundra system in order to facilitate launching from their territory and ensure coverage throughout the entire former USSR territory. Examples of HEO systems are Molnya, Tundra, Loopus, Archimedes and Borealis of the El-lipso system. The Borealis configuration is a part of Ellipso hybrid satellite constellation, which has to be presented as a Hybrid Satellite Orbit (HSO). The HEO satellite constellation turned for 180<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup> will be able to cover territories of Southern Hemisphere including South Africa.

articleTitle: Space-charge limited current of charged particle beam in coaxial drift chamber
abstract: Using the strong guide magnetic field approximation, an analytical expression for limiting current of a charged particle beam propagating in a coaxial drift chamber is obtained. We fulfill a comparative analysis of the obtained analytical expression for the limiting current with results of numerical simulations. The limiting current values in the coaxial and cylindrical drift chambers are confronted. We also study the limiting current dependence on the beam parameters and dimensions.

articleTitle: Low Earth Orbits (LEO)
abstract: The handheld portable satellite phones, semifixed satellite payphones and remote offices including Satellite Broadband, Satellite Asset Tracking and Fleet Management (SATFM), Satellite Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) or Machine-to-Machine (M2M) monitoring, control, command and logistics system are a very new communications tools available for business people, all professionals in transportation, oil/gas and remote environments and everyone who likes to have satellite messaging or telephone access using Little or Big LEO satellite systems at sea, on the land and in the air. Otherwise, the different nomenclature of LEO satellites is usually known as Non-GEO (Geostationary Earth Orbits) satellites. Compared to the Little LEO systems, the bigger size of the Big LEO system enables more complex data processing in the LEO communication satellite than the simple non-voice store-and-forward feature of SATFM in the Little LEO systems. The Big LEO Mobile Satellite Systems (MSS) provide a wide variety of services, such as voice, data and Fax, Internet, SMS and paging, search and rescue, disaster services, environmental and industrial monitoring, cargo tracking and location, position determination, etc.

articleTitle: 3GPP LTE access network planning
abstract: Algorithms of LTE network planning that maximize the network coverage were considered. As a result of using of the method of modified frequency planning the enhancement of subscriber base was showed by means of program ICS Telecom.

articleTitle: Experimental determination of power handling level for MMIC limiter
abstract: In the present article an experimental determination of power handling level for MMIC limiter is presented. This limiter is made on base of Schottky diode. The experimental characteristics are shown.

articleTitle: Fractal nature of resitance of the drain-dopped channel of the GaN-based heterostructure of the field effect transistor with bidimensional electron gas
abstract: It is shown that the specific resistivity of ρ 2D-channel of the drain-dropped HEMT-transistor based on GaN heterostructure in local approximation depends on its linear dimensions l and d and if they are getting smaller it may become even bigger, that specifies the fractal nature of this effect. In course of the experiment there was defined that the limit value of local approximation L=60 um specifies that linear sizes of the active elements of modern HEMT-transistors come into the sphere of local approximation and should subject to fractal geometry laws. To these laws we refer the dependence of electrophysical parameters of the facilities being measured on their sizes and slower dependence on the characterization sizes usually associated with linear dependence.

articleTitle: Application of the terahertz non-stationary gas spectroscopy for monitoring of superecotoxic agents
abstract: The application of the non-stationary gas spectroscopy method of terahertz frequency range for monitoring of superecotoxic agents and poisonous substances was considered. The results of spectroscopic investigations of acetone, ammonia, dichloroethane and lewisite were presented.

articleTitle: Microwave transceiver module with quadrature frequency converter. SAR mode operation
abstract: The millimeter wave length transceiver with a linear frequency control and quadrature frequency converter has been developed and investigated. It consists of FET VCO, a buffer amplifier and a quadrature frequency converter (QFC). Presence of QFC allows implementing aperture synthesis techniques and creating a compact microwave radar operating in SAR mode.

articleTitle: Efficiency of coaxial klinoorotron
abstract: The coaxial klinoorotron with inhomogeneous focusing magnetic field in which the klinotron effect is applied to improve the efficiency of energy exchange between the tubular electron beam and electromagnetic field of the open coaxial cavity is investigated. It is shown that in this device with double electron optics at f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 100 GHz and at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 2,8 kV, B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0max</sub> ~ 0,4...0,436 T, B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0min</sub> = 0,266...0,338 T, I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 3...10 A of relatively thick double electron beams (Δr/r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 0,01) the efficiency 10... 18 % is achieved.

articleTitle: Cavity method for determination of dielectric characteristics of fine granular materials in 8-mm range of wavelengths
abstract: A resonator method and results of investigation of dielectric characteristics of bulk materials in the 8-mm range of wavelengths are presented. Accuracy of experimental estimation of dielectric constant and loss-angle tangent 5 of mixture of sand and cement are investigated in the process of manufacturing of a dielectric resonator from the probed material and exciting on modes of "whispering gallery".

articleTitle: Development of up-to-date sea surface-object monitory radar facility "Burevestnik-1" installed at naval and sea border guard surveilance point
abstract: The makeup and technical data of the state-of-the art X-band radar system referred to as “Burevestnik-1” have been described. This system is designed to ensure engineering supervision and sea-surface objects monitoring when accommodated at surveillance outposts, on river boats, sea-going vessels including high-speed ships.

articleTitle: Wideband microstrip antennas and antenna arrays for L-band
abstract: The results of development and manufacturing of wideband microstrip antennas and cylindrical microstrip antenna arrays are presented. Developed microstrip antennas have frequency band up to 50% and switchable antenna array works in 1.5–1.8 GHz band.

articleTitle: Heterostructure P-I-N diodes
abstract: Heterostructure microwave beam lead p-i-n diodes are developed. Parameters of diodes were measured in a frequency range from 0.1 to 40 GHz. Insertion loss does not exceed 0.35 dB (I=10 mA). The diode capacitance was 30 fF. It is shown that diodes intensively radiate light with wave-lengths of 900-910 nanometers.

articleTitle: An experimental recovery of GaAs and GaN PHEMT linear equivalent circuits and noise models
abstract: In the present article an experimental recovery of GaAs and GaN PHEMT linear equivalent circuit and noise model are presented. The linear equivalent circuit and noise mode for two types of PHEMT manufactured by FSUE RPC “Istok” (molecular beam epitaxy structure on GaAs and GaN) are recovered.

articleTitle: Microwave tunable filters with impedance step
abstract: Calculation of resonant frequencies and the characteristics for the coupling coefficients of quarter-wave resonators with an impedance step are discussed. The problems of numerical calculation and synthesis of filters based on resonators with stepped heterogeneity are considered, experimental results are submitted for consideration.

articleTitle: Study of scanning microwave tomography of subsurface targets
abstract: Results of numerical simulation of the scanning microwave tomography of dielectric objects based on the inverse scattering problem solution by 2D data of multi-frequency near-surface microwave measurements are presented. Modeling has been carried out both for continuously distributed inhomogeneities of the complex permittivity and for homogeneous rectangular objects. Results demonstrate the reliability of the algorithm of the inverse problem solution and make it possible to determine the achievable accuracy and quality of the considered tomography with the available equipment.

articleTitle: A tunable hexaferrite dielectric resonator for W-band devices
abstract: Magnetic field tuning characteristics of a single-crystal barium hexaferrite dielectric resonator in the frequency range 75-110 GHz are reported. The dielectric resonances occur at a much higher frequency than the ferromagnetic resonance. It is shown that the degeneracy in the dielectric mode is lifted with an applied magnetic field H and that the modes can be tuned by 10 GHz or more with H. The dielectric modes are of importance for the realization of low-loss devices, including resonators, isolators and phase shifters.

articleTitle: Microwave control system of state change of gaseous atmosphere in mines
abstract: The microwave monitoring system of state change of gas environment in the mines based on the use of the electromagnetic method for level detection of integral concentration of its separate components in order to prevent accidents in coal mines.

articleTitle: The analysis and processing of experimental time series in systems of automated control
abstract: Application of wavelet transformations for processing and analysis of experimental time series in the systems of automated control is considered. The mathematical model and algorithms of processing and analysis of the data is developed.

articleTitle: Surface magnon polariton modes in the open through passage resonator partially filled ferrite
abstract: The problem of eigenmodes of an open transmission resonator with gyrotropic ferrite medium is theoretically solved and existence of surface magnon polariton (SMP) modes with field high concentration on border of the ferrite resonator is determined. All possible combined modes of existence of surfaced and volumetric modes are analyzed, dependences of their resonant frequencies vs. medium material parameters and resonator and ferrite layer geometrical sizes are determined.

articleTitle: Microwave measurement of crude oil water content under inversion of water-oil emulsion
abstract: Features of microwave measurement of water content in crude oil under inversion of water-oil emulsion are considered. Experimental results of the designed water content measuring device are presented.

articleTitle: Ultra wideband directional coupler with matching resistive elements
abstract: The compact broadband directional coupler with resistive elements is modeled. The frequency characteristics of the device are compared to the corresponding characteristics of the prototype with matching conductive elements.

articleTitle: The automated system for polarization scattering diagram measuring by quasioptical waveguide modeling technique
abstract: The automated system for polarization scattering diagram measuring by quasioptical waveguide modeling (QWM) technique has been developed. The basic elements of automated system have been described briefly.

articleTitle: L-S-band Schottky diode limiter
