abstract: This paper presents results of design and fabrication of monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) Schottky diode limiter. These limiters have a small size and technological compatibility with ion-implanted low-noise field-effect transistors. The experimental characteristics are given.

articleTitle: WEB 2.0 and scientific research: Two-level concept
abstract: Considered in this paper are the possibilities and peculiarities of creating knowledge portal on the basis of ontologies, as well as basic ontologies of scientific knowledge portal and offline knowledge avantportal. Proposed is two-level concept for development of scientific knowledge portal. According to this concept, the “lower” level (resource) is digital library, created on the basis of ontologies, with metadata about this resource in the “upper” level, which realizes on of the variants of CMS organization.

articleTitle: Influence of external electromagnetic radiation on current voltage characteristics of quantun wire
abstract: It is demonstrated that external electromagnetic radiation may induce the voltage between contacts of quantum wire.

articleTitle: Rapid development of data-intensive web services
abstract: This paper presents an authoring tool which makes possible to create data intensive Web services in a graphical manner. It enables people without programming skills to develop this category of Web Services. Besides addressing the workflow for using this tool, its technological background is presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Low loss microwave solid GaAs SPST switch of range 18–40 GHz
abstract: The broadband microwave monolithic GaAs SPST MMIC of the range 18 to 40 GHz with dimensions 1.8 × 1.1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> has been presented. Insertion loss no more than 2.3 dB and isolation no more than 32 dB have been achieved.

articleTitle: Monolithic integrated circuit of limiters on basis of P-I-N diodes
abstract: The paper presents the design and performance of broadband monolithic GaAs p-i-n diode limiter. MIC has low-signal insertion loss. The leakage power of the limiter is about 16.5 dBm and it can handle CW power level up to 37 dBm.

articleTitle: Production of 150 NM T-gate on basis of Ti/Mo/Cu for p-HEMT
abstract: Technology of manufacturing of 0,15 μm T-gate Ti/Mo/Cu on heterostructure GaAs/AlGaAs/InGaAs using the electron-beam lithography in the tri-layer resist mask 950PMMA/ LOR 5B/ 495PMMA is described in the work.

articleTitle: Local positioning of objects
abstract: The principle of local measurement of distance to moving objects is considered. It implements two different measurement methods, one of them supplements another for exact positioning. Accuracy of the given method is very high, as signals of microwave band are used.

articleTitle: Modified operating regime of gallium arsenide Gunn diodes with thin base
abstract: Modified operating conditions of Gunn diode, SHF value of which on the first harmonic is determined by pumping processes in the charge layer and its diffusion, rather than by domain transit time, excludes frequency dependence of generation on domain transit time. This significantly extends the frequency range of the diode to 30–48 GHz. The reduced impact of a dead zone along with optimization of the dopant profile significantly increases efficiency rate of the diode to values 5–7% at input power 160–140 mW over the whole frequency range and operating current 0.55 A.

articleTitle: Short range optical communication systems for vehicles and airplanes
abstract: This paper deals mainly with state of the art and next-decade technologies for fiber-optic data buses in automotive applications. Nowadays, fiber-optic data buses in automotive applications are exclusively used in the infotainment domain, MOST (Media Oriented System Transport). Current data rates are in the order of 150 MBit/s. Consequently, the use of LEDs and polymer optical fibers (POF) is sufficient. For higher data rates, also alternative solutions are discussed: The LED as transmitter can be replaced by a vertical surface emitting laser (VCSEL) and the plastic fiber (POF) by polymer-cladded silica (PCS) fiber. Due to the inherent fact that, as a result, the fiber diameter is reduced, the detector area of the well-known Silicon photo diodes can also be reduced greatly. As a consequence, data rates can be extended into the Gbit/s-region.

articleTitle: Method of computation of electrical parameters of transdirectional coupler
abstract: The method of computation of electrical parameters of a directional coupler on the base of two coupled lines, which provides the required distribution of input signal from primary line between the outputs of the second line, is offered. With this objection in mind the additional reactances by means of which high level of isolation and input matching are achieved, are used.

articleTitle: Wireless covert communications with code spectrum modulation of UWB noise signals
abstract: The theoretical analysis and simulation results of ultra wideband wireless covert communications with code spectrum modulation of noise continuous waveforms are presented.

articleTitle: Technology terahertz — Medicine
abstract: Unique properties and biophysical effects of terahertz range implemented in medical devices are considered. Harmlessness of use of the given frequencies for a human body, perspective and efficiency of introduction in medical devices is proved. Importance and advantages of terahertz devices developed in our country and abroad are shown in comparison with similar devices.

articleTitle: Consideration of physical constraints for regression line fitting in the task of blind mixed noise variance evaluation on images
abstract: The modification of blind method for mixed noise variance evaluation is proposed. The modification concerns adding constraints for location of a regression line fitted in the scatter-plot of local variance and squared mean estimation pairs. The accuracy improvement is shown by numerical simulations for artificial and real life test images.

articleTitle: Molecular single-electron transistor on basis of planar nanostructure
abstract: The investigation of the effects of correlated tunneling in the molecular nanostructures at room temperatures has been carried out. The model of molecular single-electron transistor on the basis of planar techniques has been developed.

articleTitle: Self-consistent theory of Smith-Purcell effect at harmonics of bwo frequency in the double-mode parametric oscillator
abstract: The non-linear theory of Smith-Purcell effect on harmonics of BWO frequency taking into account the two-mode interaction — self-consistent BWO mode and the distributed parametric mode of the diffraction radiation on harmonics of BWO frequency is developed. On the basis of the numerical solution of the self-consistent equations set the existence of the BWO mode of oscillations and parametric type amplification of the diffraction radiation on BWO harmonics is shown.

articleTitle: Radiation effects in microwave devices based on gallium nitride
abstract: The review of radiation effects on GaN microwave semiconductor devices is presented.

articleTitle: OVSF code assignment in UMTS networks
abstract: 3G networks are designed to provide voice, data and multimedia services in an efficient way. The 3G system has to provide all of these applications with higher and multirate and different quality of service (QoS) requirements. UMTS employs wide-band code division multiple access (WCDMA) to support multi-rate applications utilizing OVSF codes. The transmission rate can be easily changed by changing the spreading factor of orthogonal spreading code. The objective of code assignment is to enhance statistical multiplexing and spectral efficiency of W-CDMA systems supporting variable user data rates. This paper compares the performance of OVSF code assignment schemes, in terms of code blocking probability. We research the problem of assigning orthogonal variable spreading factor (OVSF) codes at the download link in 3G mobile communications systems employing WCDMA.

articleTitle: Impact exerted by fractal pattern of ionized shallow-level donor impurity distribution on specific resistance of active layer of structure of field-effect transistor
abstract: It has been found that dependence of specific resistance ρ of the active GaAs layer in Schottky-barrier of structures of the field-effect transistor on width d and length l of the inflow-outflow channel in local approximation at d, l<;L is an indicator of its fractal nature. Reduction of d and l at d, l<;L results in significant increase in ρ. It has been shown that the value of local approximation limit L is an important characteristic of semiconducting material, which defines limits of its applicability for determination of its electric characteristics (specific resistance), as well as limits of its applicability for design of semiconductor devices under given instrumental characteristics.

articleTitle: Antennas for Meteosat satellites
abstract: The paper describes antenna activities for Meteosat program developed under ESA's technical management. The program started in the 70's and the first satellite was launched in 1977 with VLF, UHF, L- and S-band antennas. The operational Meteosat satellites carried UHF, L- and S-band antennas. Antennas for the Second Generation Meteosat have been discussed in [1]. This paper contributes in complement with early antenna configurations as used for the pre-operational and operational Meteosat program. Together with [1] it provides a description of > 35 year of antenna activities for spinning spacecrafts for the Meteosat program.

articleTitle: Current tendencies of developing of digital teraherz radiosystems
abstract: Current tendencies and ways of production of digital radiosystems, working in the frequency range near 100GHz with the use of nanoelectronic components for transmition of the high-speed flows of data with velocities from 100Mb/s to a few Gb/s is explored in the article. The application of such frequencies allows installing of unlimited amount of transmitters or/and receivers of different service providers on a single territory and exploit a single frequency. Advantages of the use of the radio channel of the terahertz range, possible spheres of the deployment, problems and possible methods of their solution are also considered.

articleTitle: High speed amplitude millimeter wave switches of inverse type
abstract: The article concerns the results of analysis of frequency characteristics of fast amplitude switches of inverse type in the millimeter wave range with the use of the silicon diode p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-structures mounted in a dielectric package. The dielectric package is considered in the form of the radial line with the distributed parameters which ensure transforming of input impedance of a transmission line to the diode structure switching terminals in order to realize a parallel resonance condition in a switch circuit in microwave power transmission mode. Requirements are determined for the diode parameters and construction providing realization of the optimum operating mode of the switch in a working band.

articleTitle: Experimental research of the dual-band array with cosecant-shape Far-field pattern
abstract: Experimental investigation of the array with cosecant-shape Far-field pattern, working in L-band (1030-1090 MHz; 1450-1550 MHz) is presented. Comparison Results of the given date with the results of the computer simulation using Ansoft HFSS program are presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of control mechanism of parameters of microstrip transmission line on semicondactor substrate
abstract: The section of a microstrip line on a semiconductor substrate was investigated at frequency range 5 to 15 Hz. Gallium arsenide was chosen as a material of the semiconductor substrate. In this report results of numerical simulation of phase-frequency and amplitude-frequency responses of power transmission coefficient through section of MLSS with proper frequency responses of complex transmission constant are compared. It is shown that control mechanism in MLSS is based on two factors - resonance effects of section of MLSS and changing of attenuation constant.

articleTitle: Active log-periodic antennas for spatial and quasi-optical microwave power combining
abstract: Power combining in the array of microwave oscillators, consisted of log-periodical antennas with field-effect transistors as active elements, is experimentally studied. The opportunity for considerable improvement of oscillation efficiency due to the mutual synchronization is shown and conditions of formation of the radiation pattern are defined.

articleTitle: Two models of medical radio thermometer
abstract: The problems of measurement of electromagnetic self-radiation of biological objects as well as the principles of design of medical diagnostic devices on their basis are discussed. Two models of a medical radio thermometer are described: for 8-cm and 25-cm wave lengths.

articleTitle: Microwave module for noncontact measurement of semiconductors
abstract: Controlled microwave module for sensing of semiconductors is developed. The results of its application for measurement of minority-carrier lifetime in silicon are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of gratings made from conducting wire elements on electromagnetic properties of radio absorbing coating
abstract: Electromagnetic properties of radio absorbing coating which structure includes periodic gratings made from conducting wire elements are investigated. It is established that the use of periodic gratings allows improving of radio absorbing properties of known types of materials with electric nature of absorption.

articleTitle: Polar Earth Orbits (PEO)
abstract: The results of a technical and economic study regarding the extension of the Inmarsat Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) system to cover polar region are reviewed. In addition, also are examined the technical and practical aspects of providing an operational polar Mobile Satellite Service (MSS) for the provision of combined distress and safety service in conjunction with a commercial and defense communication systems for maritime, land and aeronautical applications. This study is considered several Polar Earth Orbits (PEO) models and their probable costs for Search and Rescue (SAR) and determination MSS solutions. The practical usage of Low PEO constellation is realized by Cospas-Sarsat international project for Satellite Distress and Safety Systems (SDSS).

articleTitle: Multipath amplification in UWB communication systems with chaotic signals
abstract: The effect of multipath amplification in the communication system with chaotic radio pulses has been investigated. For 3-10 GHz range the effect develops from the pulse length 20 nsec. The estimates show multipath gain from 4 to 13-14 dB depending on propagation conditions. Multipath amplification substantially improves performance of chaotic communication systems.

articleTitle: 150 Mbps PDIC receiver
abstract: A 150 Mbps PDIC (Photo Diode Integrated Circuit) BiCMOS optical receiver is presented in the report. The receiver is intended to be used in the MOST150 (Media Oriented System Transport) network with POF (Plastic Optical Fiber), diameter 1 mm wavelength 650nm. A fast optical front end receiver is developed based on XFAB BiCMOS technology. The fully differential receiver consists of two integrated photo diodes with 1.1mm diameter, transimpedance amplifier, postamplifier and output LVDS driver. The block diagram, chip layout and measurement results of the engineering samples are shown. Receiver is available in two types of the package SOIC and SIP.

articleTitle: Formation of super-Gaussian fields in open two-mirror resonators
abstract: The characteristics of excitation of oscillations in the open resonator (OR) with super-Gaussian fields, as a resonant system of diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) in THz have been considered. The results of theoretical researches of the spectral distribution and the structure of fields in two-dimensional OR and experimental evidence of modes of excitation in three-dimensional OR with super-Gaussian fields are shown.

articleTitle: Dispersion compensation with use of DCF fiber
abstract: Principles necessary for the increase of anti-jamming abilities, transmission performances and reliability of functioning of Fiber-optic Communication System due to diminishing of influence of dispersion by means of simulation of three different schemes pre-, post-, and symmetrical compensation with the use of fiber DCF are developed.

articleTitle: Microwave monolithic integrated circuit wideband limiter
abstract: Study results of microwave monolithic integrated circuit (MMIC) wideband limiter are presented. The results show that a three-stage back-to-back diode pairs limiter provides more wide frequency range than a two-stage one.

articleTitle: Optimization of moving object segments with application of conditional probability distribution
abstract: A new approach for selection of image moving objects with application of statistical optimization of moving object segments with application of conditional probability distribution is considered.

articleTitle: Upgrading directions of satellite communication
abstract: Upgrading directions of satellite communication systems (fixed, broadcasting, mobile) on the basis of increasing their transmission capacity, improvement of quality of information transfer, scalability are considered. Satellite communication systems (SCS) are currently the main means of providing services to television and radio, international scale. They are widely used for communication: in areas with poor infrastructure and complex terrain to provide mobile services of a global scale. At the same time, SCS's are inferior in terms of capacity and quality of transmission, terrestrial fiber optic backbone, radio relay lines and radio systems, local area networks (LAN, MAN). In this regard, the global satellite industry companies and international operators are continuously improving tools and systems for the SCS to improve their competitiveness.

articleTitle: Simulating of double-channel heterotransistor with quantum dots
abstract: A heterostructure transistor with quantum dots (QD) is a perspective device due to its increase of electrons' drift velocity in the channel. In this work simulation results of doublechannel heterotransistor with QD are present. QD application causes significant drain current increasing.

articleTitle: Metallization on the basis of binary and ternary alloys for submicron elements of MEMS RF-microswitches formation
abstract: Features of structure of aluminum metallization on the basis of binary and ternary alloys for submicron elements of MEMS formation are considered. It is shown, that use of ternary alloys Al+Si+Cu and Al+Si+Ho at temperature of a substrate 250-280°C leads to formation of the most fine-grained films of the metallization giving reproducible profiles of anodizing at formation of submicron elements of MEMS RF-microswitches.

articleTitle: Gyrotron-based systems for microwave technologies
abstract: The recent results of development of technological gyrotron complexes in IAP RAS are presented. Second harmonic 24 GHz CW gyrotron has been developed and tested. Record-breaking efficiency of 60% at 6kW output power has been obtained by optimization of a profile of magnetic field and single-stage energy recovery of the spent electron beam. The electron beam with pitch factor higher than 2 and velocity spread about 10% was experimentally obtained using electron gun of a new type.

articleTitle: SHF stand for performing high-temperature chemical processes
abstract: SHF stand for performing high-temperature chemical processes is designed. SHF stand includes high-Q cavity excited on H 102 mode and the magnetron SHF generator of the level of SHF power of 1 kW, the operating frequency of 2470±100 MHz. The power of energy release up to 100 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, the rate of heating is more than 1000 °C/sec. The study of selective catalytic pyrolysis of high-molecular hydrocarbons is performed. The formation of carbon nanostructure from alkanes has studied.

articleTitle: Automation of adjustment of phased-array antennas
abstract: Principles of construction of hardware-software complex for fast adjustment of phased-array antenna, monitoring for deviation of measuring probe, automation of phase corrections matching process, emulation of work of phase-shifting unit have been declared. Reduced inspection analysis of electrical parameters of phased-array antennas is carried out, a control program for a phase-shifter control unit is created, fast correction of the control program of phase-shifter control unit is performed.

articleTitle: Electrically programmed tellurium based thin-film memory element
abstract: Transition of thin film memory element based on tellurium in a metastable state with quasimetallic conductivity is followed by structural transformations, which leads to a charge ordering of electron density as a result of reallocation of atoms with different valences. The memory effects in these structures are conditioned by cooperative effects of interacting dipole complexes.

articleTitle: Coaxial waveguide-microstrip transformer-junction
abstract: The design embodiment and calculation approaches related to a longitudinally coaxial waveguide-microstrip junction have been considered.

articleTitle: Distribution of currents in film metalloidelectric structures at influence of powerful electromagnetic fields
abstract: On the basis of numerically-analytical model of influence of powerful electromagnetic fields on film metal-dielectric structures are obtained distributions of currents of displacement and conductivity.

articleTitle: On the research problem of energy informative devices of modern medicine
abstract: Two methods and results of experimental research of energy informative devices used for water structuring and correction of the human functional state are presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of non-uniform relief coupled microstrip lines by the "growing" method
abstract: Synthesis of the sizes of the irregular relief coupled microstrip lines, which conductors are carried out on orthogonally placed substrates, is carried out. The synthesis algorithm is based on a method of "growing" of cross-section structure on the set primary parameters in the form of capacities matrixes.

articleTitle: A hybrid approach for user activity experiments on Internet of Services platforms
abstract: The Internet of Services (IoS) idea promotes collaborative service exchange and trading platforms. Activity in the IoS is determined by metrics such as the number of users, number of services with associated descriptions and contract templates, negotiated contracts, performed invocations and generated measurements. In order to develop scalable and high-quality IoS platforms, experiments with user activity simulations are needed to achieve realistic metrics. We present a hybrid approach to keep the amount of simulation to a minimum based on evolving real IoS system replication.

articleTitle: Satellite component in technology of construction of telecommunication network of digital teleradiobroadcasting
abstract: Generalized configuration of telecommunication network of digital air television and radio broadcasting of Ukraine is presented in the form of functional and structural diagrams. The place and the role of satellite distributing network of infware is showed.

articleTitle: Chaotic radiopulse generation on the basis of passive synchronization of the self-modulation frequencies of a microwave signal
abstract: In this paper the self-generation of a periodic sequence of the chaotic Mw pulses in the ring chaos generator with the magnetostatic wave signal-to-noise enhancer is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Workflows automatization of scientific-pedagogical activities in higher education institutions
abstract: An approach for automatization of scientific-pedagogical activities in universities informational environment on the basis of Windows Workflow Foundation and Microsoft SharePoint 2010 technologies was suggested. It allows increasing in efficiency of collaboration between tutors and students. As an example, realization of workflow “Control of students' academic performance” is given.

articleTitle: Miniature suspended-substrate stripline filter
abstract: A new suspended-substrate stripline structure admitting implementation of miniature highly selective narrowband filters is studied. The diminutiveness of the structure is achieved due to introducing supplementary strip conductors, which considerably reduce the coupling between the resonators. Furthermore, in this case attenuation poles arise on both sides of the passband appreciably improving the device selectivity. Experimental results of the manufactured four-resonator filter are presented.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous educational cluster for high-performance MPI-computing
abstract: The approach of high-performance platform design, based on the Message Passing Interface (MPI) implementation MPICH2, is proposed. It allows conducting the processing of hard processes on non-specialized equipment. The value of throughput depending of various parameters was analyzed.

articleTitle: Radio frequency sensors on base of generalized transformers of immittance
abstract: The circuit design of radio frequency sensors (RFS) of remote condition monitoring of an object was generalized, the classification of RFS is given and possible technical solutions for implementation and use of RFS are considered.

articleTitle: On using of a stop-layer for thermal conduction increasing in devices based on GaAs
abstract: A design of an active device on GaAs with a stop-layer under an active structure is proposed. It makes possible to implement effective heat removing through the filled well from the wafer bottom. Simulation has shown doubling of thermal conductance.

articleTitle: To 60th anniversary of Professor Pestrikov Viktor Mikhaylovich
abstract: DIscusses the 60th anniversary of Professor Pestrikov Viktor Mikhaylovich.

articleTitle: Comparison of 1-D and 2-D models for microwave control diodes
abstract: 2-D models are used to evaluate the influence of surface recombination on the characteristics of a microwave switch diode.
